class Trie
  property root : Node

  class Node
    property children : Array(Node?)
    property value : Char?
    property end_set : Int32

    def initialize(@value)
      @children = Array(Node?).new(26, nil)
      @end_set = 0_i32
    end
  end

  def initialize
    @root = Node.new(nil)
  end

  def insert(s : String, suffix : Char)
    node = @root
    s.chars.each do |c|
      i = c - 'a'
      if node.children[i].nil?
        node.children[i] = Node.new(c)
      end
      node = node.children[i].not_nil!
    end
    node.end_set |= (1 << (suffix - 'a'))
  end
end

def dfs(node, end_set)
  node.children.each_with_index do |child, i|
    next if child.nil?
    26.times do |j|
      if ((child.end_set >> j) & 1) != 0
        end_set[i] += 1
      end
    end
  end

local mfl, mce = math.floor, math.ceil
local mmi, mma = math.min, math.max
local bls, brs = bit.lshift, bit.rshift
local SegTree = {}
SegTree.updateAll = function(self)
  for i = self.stagenum - 1, 1, -1 do
    local cnt = bls(1, i - 1)
    for j = 1, cnt do
      self.stage[i][j] = self.func(self.stage[i + 1][j * 2 - 1], self.stage[i + 1][j * 2])
    end
  end
end
SegTree.create = function(self, n, func, emptyvalue)
  self.func, self.emptyvalue = func, emptyvalue
  local stagenum, mul = 1, 1
  self.stage = {{}}
  while mul < n do
    mul, stagenum = mul * 2, stagenum + 1
    self.stage[stagenum] = {}
  end
  self.stagenum = stagenum
  self.left_stage = {}
  for i = 1, n do
    local sp, sz = 1, bls(1, stagenum - 1)
    while(i - 1) % sz ~= 0 do
      sp, sz = sp + 1, brs(sz, 1)
    end
    self.left_stage[i] = sp
  end
  self.sz_stage = {}
  local tmp, sp = 1, stagenum
  for i = 1, n do
    if tmp * 2 == i then tmp, sp = tmp * 2, sp - 1 end
    self.sz_stage[i] = sp
  end
  for i = 1, mul do self.stage[stagenum][i] = emptyvalue end
  self:updateAll()
end
SegTree.getRange = function(self, left, right)
  if left == right then return self.stage[self.stagenum][left] end
  local stagenum = self.stagenum
  local ret = self.emptyvalue
  while left <= right do
    local stage = mma(self.left_stage[left], self.sz_stage[right - left + 1])
    local sz = bls(1, stagenum - stage)
    ret = self.func(ret, self.stage[stage][1 + brs(left - 1, stagenum - stage)])
    left = left + sz
  end
  return ret
end
SegTree.update = function(self, idx)
  for i = self.stagenum - 1, 1, -1 do
    local dst = brs(idx + 1, 1)
    local rem = dst * 4 - 1 - idx
    self.stage[i][dst] = self.func(self.stage[i + 1][idx], self.stage[i + 1][rem])
    idx = dst
  end
end
SegTree.setValue = function(self, idx, value, silent)
  local prv = self.stage[self.stagenum][idx]
  self.stage[self.stagenum][idx] = value
  if prv ~= value and not silent then
    self:update(idx)
  end
end
SegTree.right_bound_lcp = function(self, val, left, right)
  local retpos = left - 1
  local l, r = left, right
  local stage = mma(self.left_stage[left], self.sz_stage[right - left + 1])
  local stagenum = self.stagenum
  while true do
    local sz = bls(1, stagenum - stage)
    if val <= self.stage[stage][mce(l / sz)] then
      retpos = l + sz - 1
      if retpos == right then break end
      if l + sz <= r then
        l = l + sz
        stage = mma(self.left_stage[l], self.sz_stage[r - l + 1])
      else break end
    else
      if sz ~= 1 then stage, r = stage + 1, l + sz - 2
      else break end
    end
  end
  return retpos + 1
end
SegTree.new = function(n, func, emptyvalue)
  local obj = {}
  setmetatable(obj, {__index = SegTree})
  obj:create(n, func, emptyvalue)
  return obj
end

for i = 1, n do
  local s = io.read():reverse()
  if 1 < #s then
    prefix[i] = s:sub(1, #s - 1)
    suffix[i] = s:sub(#s, #s)
  else
    prefix[i] = ""
    suffix[i] = s
  end
  idx_prefix[i] = i
end

table.sort(idx_prefix, function(a, b) return prefix[a] < prefix[b] end)
local idx_prefix_inv = {}
for i = 1, n do idx_prefix_inv[i] = i end
for i = 1, n do
  idx_prefix_inv[idx_prefix[i]] = i
end

local st_lcp = SegTree.new(n, mmi, 0)

for i = 1, n - 1 do
  local src, dst = idx_prefix[i], idx_prefix[i + 1]
  local z = mmi(#prefix[src], #prefix[dst])
  local l = 0
  for j = 1, z do
    if prefix[src]:byte(j) == prefix[dst]:byte(j) then l = j
    else break
    end
  end
  st_lcp:setValue(i, l, true)
end
st_lcp:updateAll()

for i = 1, n do idx_length[i] = i end
table.sort(idx_length, function(a, b) return #prefix[a] < #prefix[b] end)
local cur_maxlen = #prefix[idx_length[n]]
for i = n, 1, -1 do
  local original_idx = idx_length[i]
  if #prefix[original_idx] < cur_maxlen then
    for j = i + 1, n do
      local tgt = idx_length[j]
      local tgt_prefix_idx = idx_prefix_inv[tgt]
      for k = #prefix[original_idx] + 1, cur_maxlen do
        local v = prefix[tgt]:byte(k) - 96
        st_char_by_prefix[v]:setValue(tgt_prefix_idx, 1)
      end
    end
    cur_maxlen = #prefix[original_idx]
  end
  local prefix_idx = idx_prefix_inv[original_idx]
  local rb = st_lcp:right_bound_lcp(#prefix[original_idx], prefix_idx, n)
  rb = mmi(n, rb)
  local suf = suffix[original_idx]:byte() - 96
  if prefix_idx <= rb then
    ret = ret + st_char_by_prefix[suf]:getRange(prefix_idx, rb)
  end
  st_char_by_prefix[suf]:setValue(prefix_idx, 1)
end

count :: Int -> Int -> Int
count p 0 = -1
count p a = go 0 a
  where
    go !cnt !a | r /= 0 = cnt
               | otherwise = go (cnt+1) q
      where (q,r) = divMod a p

    let ct2 = count 2 (fromInteger val)
        ct5 = count 5 (fromInteger val)
    return (if ct2 < 0 then 9 else min 9 $ ct2-9,

  matLin <- VUM.replicate (19*19) (0 :: Int)

    VUM.modify (matMut V.! (ct2+9)) (+1) (ct5+9)
  mat <- linToMat 19 19 <$> VU.unsafeFreeze matLin
  print $ V.sum $ (`V.imap` mat) $ \ !xi !rowx ->
    V.sum $ (`V.map` V.drop (max xi (18-xi)) (V.indexed mat))
    $ \ (!yi,!rowy) ->
    VU.sum $ (`VU.imap` rowx) $ \ !xj !valx ->
    let dropped | xi < yi = 18-xj
                | otherwise = max xj (18-xj)
    in VU.sum $ (`VU.map` VU.drop dropped (VU.indexed rowy))
    $ \ (!yj,!valy) ->
        if xi == yi && xj == yj
        then (`div` 2) $ valx * (valx-1)
        else valx * valy
  return ()

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \r -> case r of
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

data Tree = Branch { singletons :: !IntSet, longers :: !(IntMap Tree) }

emptyTree :: Tree
emptyTree = Branch IS.empty IMS.empty

insertTree :: BS.ByteString -> Tree -> Tree
insertTree (BSW.uncons -> Just (x,xs)) br@Branch{..}
  | BS.null xs = br {singletons = IS.insert (fromIntegral x) singletons}
  | otherwise  =
    br {longers = IMS.alter
                  (Just . insertTree xs . fromMaybe emptyTree)
                  (fromIntegral x)
                  longers}
insertTree _ _ = error "insertTree: empty Char"

countInTree :: BS.ByteString -> Tree -> Int
countInTree xs tree = go 0 im xs tree
  where
    im = IMS.fromListWith (+) $ map ((,1::Int) . fromIntegral)
      $ BSW.unpack xs
    go !acc !histo (BSW.uncons -> Just (!x,!xs)) Branch{..}
      | BS.null xs = acc
      | Just tr <- IMS.lookup (fromIntegral x) longers
      = go (acc + IS.size (IS.intersection singletons (IMS.keysSet histo)))
           (IMS.update (\x -> if x > 1 then Just $! x-1 else Nothing)
                       (fromIntegral x) histo)
           xs
           tr
      | otherwise
      = acc + IS.size (IS.intersection singletons (IMS.keysSet histo))
    go _ _ _ _ = error "countInTree: empty String"

{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \r -> case r of
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

;; ASCII code:
;; #\A: 65
;; #\a: 97
;; #\0: 48
(declaim (inline trie-char-encode))
(defun trie-char-encode (x)
  (- (char-code x) #.(char-code #\a)))

(defconstant +trie-alphabet-size+ 26)

(declaim (inline %make-trie-node))
(defstruct (trie-node (:constructor %make-trie-node
                          (&aux
                           (dp (make-array #.+trie-alphabet-size+
                                           :element-type 'uint32
                                           :initial-element 0))
                           (children (make-array #.+trie-alphabet-size+
                                                      :element-type t
                                                      :initial-element 0)))))
  (size 0 :type (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum))
  (dp 0 :type (simple-array uint32 (*)))
  (children nil :type (simple-array t (#.+trie-alphabet-size+))))

(declaim (inline make-trie))
(defun make-trie () (%make-trie-node))

(declaim (inline trie-add!))
(defun trie-add! (trie-node string)
  "Adds STRING to the trie."
  (declare (vector string))
  (let ((end (length string)))
    (labels ((recur (node position)
               (incf (trie-node-size node))
               (unless (= position end)
                 (let ((children (trie-node-children node))
                       (char (trie-char-encode (aref string position))))
                   (when (eql 0 (aref children char))
                     (setf (aref children char) (%make-trie-node)))
                   (recur (aref children char) (+ 1 position))))))
      (recur trie-node 0)
      trie-node)))

(declaim (inline trie-get))
(defun trie-get (trie-node string)
  (declare (simple-base-string string))
  (let* ((end (length string))
         (end-char (trie-char-encode (aref string (- end 1))))
         (end-1 (- end 1)))
    (labels ((recur (node position)
               (if (= position end-1)
                   (let ((dp (trie-node-dp node)))
                     (return-from trie-get (aref dp end-char)))
                   (let ((children (trie-node-children node))
                         (char (trie-char-encode (aref string position))))
                     (if (eql 0 (aref children char))
                         0
                         (recur (aref children char) (+ 1 position)))))))
      (recur trie-node 0))))

(defun trie-build (node)
  (declare #.OPT)
  (labels ((recur (node)
             (let ((children (trie-node-children node))
                   (dp (trie-node-dp node)))
               (declare ((simple-array uint32 (*)) dp))
               (dotimes (c +trie-alphabet-size+)
                 (unless (eq 0 (aref children c))
                   (recur (aref children c))
                   (let ((children-dp (trie-node-dp (aref children c))))
                     (declare ((simple-array uint32 (*)) dp))
                     (dotimes (c2 +trie-alphabet-size+)
                       (incf (aref dp c2)
                             (the fixnum (if (= c c2)
                                             (trie-node-size (aref children c))
                                             (aref children-dp c2)))))))))))
    (recur node)))

  (let* ((n (read))

         (trie (make-trie))

    (decf res n)

table = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = Array.new(26, 0) }
paths = Array.new(N) { [] }
is_end = Hash.new(false)

nxt = 1

S.map(&:reverse).each_with_index do |s, id|
  node_id = 0

  s.chars.each_with_index do |ch, idx|
    paths[id] << node_id
    cid = ch.ord - 'a'.ord

    if table[node_id][cid] == 0
      table[node_id][cid] = nxt
      nxt += 1
    end

    node_id = table[node_id][cid]
  end

  is_end[node_id] = true
end

ans = 0

paths.each_with_index do |path, idx|
  s = S[idx].reverse
  set = Set.new
  n = path.size

  (n - 1).downto(0) do |i|
    nid = path[i]
    set.add(s[i])

    set.each do |ch|
      id = table[nid][ch.ord - 'a'.ord]
      ans += 1 if is_end[id]
    end
  end
end

#!/usr/bin/env ruby

require 'set'

class Hash
  def push(key, value)
    self[key] = [] if self[key] == nil
    self[key].push(value)
  end
end

class Array
  def lower_bound(value)
    left = -1;
    right = self.length;
    while left + 1 < right
      mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
      if self[mid] >= value
        right = mid
      else
        left = mid
      end
    end
    right
  end

  def unique
    res = [self.first]
    each_cons(2) do |a, b|
      if a != b
        res.push(b)
      end
    end
    res
  end
end

proc parseT(s: string; T: typedesc): auto =
  ## `parse` 系関数のジェネリック版
  ## `T` が `SomeOrdinal | SomeFloat` (subranges を含む) でない場合，そのまま `s` を返す
  runnableExamples:
    doAssert parseT("12", int) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", uint) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", int64) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", float32) == 12.0
    doAssert parseT("Yes", bool) == true

  when T is SomeSignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestInt(s))
  elif T is SomeUnsignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestUInt(s))
  elif T is SomeFloat: cast[T](parseFloat(s))
  elif T is enum: parseEnum[T](s)
  elif T is bool: parseBool(s)
  elif T is char: s[0]
  else: s

    doAssert tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool] is t.type

  var i = 0

      break
    x = parseT(input[i], x.type)

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))
      else:
        error("変な入力があるよ")

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  ## 入力を受け取る
  ## 宣言の後に `it` を用いた式を（`y` みたいに用いなくてもいいんだけど）いくつでもかくことができ，
  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)
  ##     d: tuple[x: char, y: float]
  ##     e: (u, v: BiggestInt)
  ##     f: tuple[u, v: int]
  ##     g: seq[int]
  ##     h: seq[a, seq[int]]
  ##     i: seq[a, (s, t: int)]
  ##     (j, k, l): int
  ##     (m, n): (char, float)
  ##     o: seq[a, string]
  ##     (p): int
  ##     q: seq[int]; it.sorted(system.cmp)
  ##     r: seq[float]; it.sorted(cmp).filterIt(it > 0)
  ##     s: seq[char]
  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]
  ##     u: string; parseInt(it); abs(-it)
  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)
  ##     (w, x): tuple[a, b: char]
  ##     y: int; "hoge"

  expectKind(body, nnkStmtList)
  result = newTree(nnkStmtList)
  var letSection = newTree(nnkLetSection)
  for decl in body:
    case decl[0].kind:
      of nnkIdent: # x: ...
        letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      of nnkPar:
        expectMinLen(decl[0], 1)
        if decl[0].len == 1: # (x): ... これは x: ... と同じ扱いにしたい
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0][0], decl[1]))
        else: # (x, y, ...): ...
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      else:
        expectKind(decl[0], {nnkIdent, nnkPar})

  result.add(letSection)

# 何しても衝突するんじゃないかと思ったので，2種類定数でとるのでいいかなって
# このテキトーな実装が嫌になったとき用の参考
# https://www.slideshare.net/nagisaeto/rolling-hash-149990902?ref=https://cards-frame.twitter.com/i/cards/tfw/v1/uc/1173504502827106305


# ほんとうは base1, base2 とかにしたかったんだけど template による数字の identifier としての連結が
# 0.19.0 以降からの機能だったので A, B, C, ... にした
type
  RollingHash* = object
    baseA, baseB: int
    mA, mB: int # modA, modB にしたかったんだけど initRollingHashMemberX の都合によりこうなった
    hashesA, hashesB: seq[int] # ハッシュ値（hashesX[i] = str[0..<i] のハッシュ値）
    powA, powB: seq[int] # powX[i] = baseX^i
  RollingHashRef* = ref RollingHash
  RollingHashTypes = RollingHash | RollingHashRef

# initImpl
template initRollingHashMemberX(self: var RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; s: string) =
  self.`pow X`[0] = 1
  for i, _ in s: self.`hashes X`[i + 1] = (self.`hashes X`[i] * self.`base X` + s[i].ord) mod self.`m X`
  for i, _ in s: self.`pow X`[i + 1] = (self.`pow X`[i] * self.`base X`) mod self.`m X`
proc initRollingHashTypesImpl(self: var RollingHashTypes; s: string) =
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(A, s)
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(B, s)

# init
# newSeq は 0.18.0 以上なら newSeqUninitialized を使いたい
proc initRollingHash*(s: string;
                      baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039;
                      mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097): RollingHash =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHash(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB,
                       mA: mA, mB: mB,
                       hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len),
                       powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)
proc newRollingHash*(s: string;
                     baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039;
                     mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097): RollingHashRef =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHashRef(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB,
                          mA: mA, mB: mB,
                          hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len),
                          powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)

# hash
template hashX(self: RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; l, r: SomeInteger): int =
  var result = self.`hashes X`[r] - self.`hashes X`[l] * self.`pow X`[r - l] mod self.`m X`
  if result < 0: result += self.`m X`
  result
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; l, r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = (self.hashX(A, l, r), self.hashX(B, l, r)) # [l, r)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; x: Slice[SomeInteger]): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = self.hash(x.a, x.b + 1)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = (self.hashesA[r], self.hashesB[r])

# 2分探索で LCP を求める
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, rs, lo, ro: SomeInteger): int = # self の文字列の [ls, rs) と other の文字列の [lo, ro) の LCP
  let len = min(rs - ls, ro - lo)
  var L = 0
  var R = len
  while R - L > 1:
    let M = (L + R) shr 1
    if self.hash(ls, ls + M) == other.hash(lo, lo + M): L = M
    else: R = M
  return L
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; sx, ox: Slice[SomeInteger]): int = LCP(self, other, sx.a, sx.b + 1, ox.a, ox.b + 1)
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, lo: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, other, ls, self.hashesA.len, lo, other.hashesA.len)
proc LCP*(self: RollingHashTypes; a, b: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, self, a, b) # S = self の文字列; S[a..^1] と S[b..^1] の LCP

const base = 29
const MOD = 46116646144580591'u
const T0 = 90193'u
var tb = Array(26, Table[uint, int])
var vis = Array(26, 1000005, false)

proc calc_hash(s:string, p:Slice[int]):uint =
  result = 0'u
  for i in countdown(p.b, p.a):
    result *= base
    result += (s[i].ord - 'a'.ord).uint
    result = result mod MOD
  result += (p.b - p.a + 1).uint * T0
  result = result mod MOD

proc main() =
  for i in 0..<tb.len: tb[i] = initTable[uint, int]()

  for i in 0..<N:
    var p = S[i][0].ord - 'a'.ord
    var l = S[i].len - 1
    let h = calc_hash(S[i], 1..<S[i].len)
    vis[p][l] = true
    tb[p][h].inc

  var ans = 0
  for s in S:
    var
      hs = newSeq[uint](s.len + 1)
      h = 0'u
    hs[s.len] = h
    for i in countdown(s.len - 1, 0):
      h *= base
      h += (s[i].ord - 'a'.ord).uint
      h = h mod MOD
      hs[i] = h
    var pref = Array(26, false)
    for i in 0..<s.len:
      pref[s[i].ord - 'a'.ord] = true
      for j in 0..<26:
        if pref[j]:
          # i + 1..<s.len
          let l = s.len - (i + 1)
          if not vis[j][l]: continue
          ans += tb[j][(hs[i + 1] + l.uint * T0) mod MOD]
  ans -= N
  print ans
  return

proc parseT(s: string; T: typedesc): auto =
  ## `parse` 系関数のジェネリック版
  ## `T` が `SomeOrdinal | SomeFloat` (subranges を含む) でない場合，そのまま `s` を返す
  runnableExamples:
    doAssert parseT("12", int) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", uint) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", int64) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", float32) == 12.0
    doAssert parseT("Yes", bool) == true

  when T is SomeSignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestInt(s))
  elif T is SomeUnsignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestUInt(s))
  elif T is SomeFloat: cast[T](parseFloat(s))
  elif T is enum: parseEnum[T](s)
  elif T is bool: parseBool(s)
  elif T is char: s[0]
  else: s

proc unpackWithParse*(input: openArray[string]; T: typedesc[tuple]): T =
  ## 文字列配列を `T` で指定された `tuple` に `parse` しながら変換する
  runnableExamples:
    let t = unpackWithParse(@["1", "1", "1", "1", "1"], 4, tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool])
    doAssert int8 is t.a.type and t.a == 1
    doAssert uint32 is t.b.type and t.b == 1
    doAssert float64 is t.c.type and t.c == 1.0
    doAssert bool is t.d.type and t.d == true
    doAssert tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool] is t.type

  var i = 0
  for x in result.fields:
    if i > input.high:
      warn "元の配列の長さが " & $T.arity & " 未満だから，一部デフォルト値になってるよ"
      break
    x = parseT(input[i], x.type)
    i.inc
  result

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))
      else:
        error("変な入力があるよ")

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  ## 入力を受け取る
  ## 宣言の後に `it` を用いた式を（`y` みたいに用いなくてもいいんだけど）いくつでもかくことができ，
  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)
  ##     d: tuple[x: char, y: float]
  ##     e: (u, v: BiggestInt)
  ##     f: tuple[u, v: int]
  ##     g: seq[int]
  ##     h: seq[a, seq[int]]
  ##     i: seq[a, (s, t: int)]
  ##     (j, k, l): int
  ##     (m, n): (char, float)
  ##     o: seq[a, string]
  ##     (p): int
  ##     q: seq[int]; it.sorted(system.cmp)
  ##     r: seq[float]; it.sorted(cmp).filterIt(it > 0)
  ##     s: seq[char]
  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]
  ##     u: string; parseInt(it); abs(-it)
  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)
  ##     (w, x): tuple[a, b: char]
  ##     y: int; "hoge"

  expectKind(body, nnkStmtList)
  result = newTree(nnkStmtList)
  var letSection = newTree(nnkLetSection)
  for decl in body:
    case decl[0].kind:
      of nnkIdent: # x: ...
        letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      of nnkPar:
        expectMinLen(decl[0], 1)
        if decl[0].len == 1: # (x): ... これは x: ... と同じ扱いにしたい
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0][0], decl[1]))
        else: # (x, y, ...): ...
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      else:
        expectKind(decl[0], {nnkIdent, nnkPar})

  result.add(letSection)

# ほんとうは base1, base2 とかにしたかったんだけど template による数字の identifier としての連結が
# 0.19.0 以降からの機能だったので A, B, C, ... にした
type
  RollingHash* = object
    baseA, baseB: int
    mA, mB: int # modA, modB にしたかったんだけど initRollingHashMemberX の都合によりこうなった
    hashesA, hashesB: seq[int] # ハッシュ値（hashesX[i] = str[0..<i] のハッシュ値）
    powA, powB: seq[int] # powX[i] = baseX^i
  RollingHashRef* = ref RollingHash
  RollingHashTypes = RollingHash | RollingHashRef

# initImpl
template initRollingHashMemberX(self: var RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; s: string) =
  self.`pow X`[0] = 1
  for i, _ in s: self.`hashes X`[i + 1] = (self.`hashes X`[i] * self.`base X` + s[i].ord) mod self.`m X`
  for i, _ in s: self.`pow X`[i + 1] = (self.`pow X`[i] * self.`base X`) mod self.`m X`
proc initRollingHashTypesImpl(self: var RollingHashTypes; s: string) =
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(A, s)
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(B, s)

# init
# newSeq は 0.18.0 以上なら newSeqUninitialized を使いたい
proc initRollingHash*(s: string;
                      baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039;
                      mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097): RollingHash =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHash(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB,
                       mA: mA, mB: mB,
                       hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len),
                       powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)
proc newRollingHash*(s: string;
                     baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039;
                     mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097): RollingHashRef =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHashRef(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB,
                          mA: mA, mB: mB,
                          hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len),
                          powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)

# hash
template hashX(self: RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; l, r: SomeInteger): int =
  var result = self.`hashes X`[r] - self.`hashes X`[l] * self.`pow X`[r - l] mod self.`m X`
  if result < 0: result += self.`m X`
  result
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; l, r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = (self.hashX(A, l, r), self.hashX(B, l, r)) # [l, r)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; x: Slice[SomeInteger]): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = self.hash(x.a, x.b + 1)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = (self.hashesA[r], self.hashesB[r])

# 2分探索で LCP を求める
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, rs, lo, ro: SomeInteger): int = # self の文字列の [ls, rs) と other の文字列の [lo, ro) の LCP
  let len = min(rs - ls, ro - lo)
  var L = 0
  var R = len
  while R - L > 1:
    let M = (L + R) shr 1
    if self.hash(ls, ls + M) == other.hash(lo, lo + M): L = M
    else: R = M
  return L
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; sx, ox: Slice[SomeInteger]): int = LCP(self, other, sx.a, sx.b + 1, ox.a, ox.b + 1)
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, lo: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, other, ls, self.hashesA.len, lo, other.hashesA.len)
proc LCP*(self: RollingHashTypes; a, b: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, self, a, b) # S = self の文字列; S[a..^1] と S[b..^1] の LCP

proc calc_hash(s:string, p:Slice[int]):uint =
  result = 0'u
  for i in countdown(p.b, p.a):
    result *= base
    result += (s[i].ord - 'a'.ord).uint
    result = result mod MOD

proc main() =

    var l = S[i].len - 1

      tb[p][l] = initTable[uint, int]()
    let h = calc_hash(S[i], 1..<S[i].len)
    tb[p][l][h].inc

  var ans = 0
  for s in S:

    hs[s.len] = h
    for i in countdown(s.len - 1, 0):

    var pref = Array(26, false)

            tb[j][l] = initTable[uint, int]()

  ans -= N
  print ans

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))
      else:
        error("変な入力があるよ")

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  ## 入力を受け取る
  ## 宣言の後に `it` を用いた式を（`y` みたいに用いなくてもいいんだけど）いくつでもかくことができ，
  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)
  ##     d: tuple[x: char, y: float]
  ##     e: (u, v: BiggestInt)
  ##     f: tuple[u, v: int]
  ##     g: seq[int]
  ##     h: seq[a, seq[int]]
  ##     i: seq[a, (s, t: int)]
  ##     (j, k, l): int
  ##     (m, n): (char, float)
  ##     o: seq[a, string]
  ##     (p): int
  ##     q: seq[int]; it.sorted(system.cmp)
  ##     r: seq[float]; it.sorted(cmp).filterIt(it > 0)
  ##     s: seq[char]
  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]
  ##     u: string; parseInt(it); abs(-it)
  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)
  ##     (w, x): tuple[a, b: char]
  ##     y: int; "hoge"

  expectKind(body, nnkStmtList)
  result = newTree(nnkStmtList)
  var letSection = newTree(nnkLetSection)
  for decl in body:
    case decl[0].kind:
      of nnkIdent: # x: ...
        letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      of nnkPar:
        expectMinLen(decl[0], 1)
        if decl[0].len == 1: # (x): ... これは x: ... と同じ扱いにしたい
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0][0], decl[1]))
        else: # (x, y, ...): ...
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      else:
        expectKind(decl[0], {nnkIdent, nnkPar})

  result.add(letSection)

type
  RollingHash* = object
    baseA, baseB: int
    mA, mB: int # modA, modB にしたかったんだけど initRollingHashMemberX の都合によりこうなった
    hashesA, hashesB: seq[int] # ハッシュ値（hashesX[i] = str[0..<i] のハッシュ値）
    powA, powB: seq[int] # powX[i] = baseX^i
  RollingHashRef* = ref RollingHash
  RollingHashTypes = RollingHash | RollingHashRef

# initImpl
template initRollingHashMemberX(self: var RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; s: string) =
  self.`pow X`[0] = 1
  for i, _ in s: self.`hashes X`[i + 1] = (self.`hashes X`[i] * self.`base X` + s[i].ord) mod self.`m X`
  for i, _ in s: self.`pow X`[i + 1] = (self.`pow X`[i] * self.`base X`) mod self.`m X`
proc initRollingHashTypesImpl(self: var RollingHashTypes; s: string) =
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(A, s)
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(B, s)

# init
# newSeq は 0.18.0 以上なら newSeqUninitialized を使いたい
proc initRollingHash*(s: string;
                      baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039;
                      mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097): RollingHash =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHash(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB,
                       mA: mA, mB: mB,
                       hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len),
                       powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)
proc newRollingHash*(s: string;
                     baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039;
                     mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097): RollingHashRef =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHashRef(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB,
                          mA: mA, mB: mB,
                          hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len),
                          powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)

# hash
template hashX(self: RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; l, r: SomeInteger): int =
  var result = self.`hashes X`[r] - self.`hashes X`[l] * self.`pow X`[r - l] mod self.`m X`
  if result < 0: result += self.`m X`
  result
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; l, r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = (self.hashX(A, l, r), self.hashX(B, l, r)) # [l, r)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; x: Slice[SomeInteger]): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = self.hash(x.a, x.b + 1)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = (self.hashesA[r], self.hashesB[r])

# 2分探索で LCP を求める
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, rs, lo, ro: SomeInteger): int = # self の文字列の [ls, rs) と other の文字列の [lo, ro) の LCP
  let len = min(rs - ls, ro - lo)
  var L = 0
  var R = len
  while R - L > 1:
    let M = (L + R) shr 1
    if self.hash(ls, ls + M) == other.hash(lo, lo + M): L = M
    else: R = M
  return L
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; sx, ox: Slice[SomeInteger]): int = LCP(self, other, sx.a, sx.b + 1, ox.a, ox.b + 1)
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, lo: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, other, ls, self.hashesA.len, lo, other.hashesA.len)
proc LCP*(self: RollingHashTypes; a, b: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, self, a, b) # S = self の文字列; S[a..^1] と S[b..^1] の LCP

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))
      else:
        error("変な入力があるよ")

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  ## 入力を受け取る
  ## 宣言の後に `it` を用いた式を（`y` みたいに用いなくてもいいんだけど）いくつでもかくことができ，
  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)
  ##     d: tuple[x: char, y: float]
  ##     e: (u, v: BiggestInt)
  ##     f: tuple[u, v: int]
  ##     g: seq[int]
  ##     h: seq[a, seq[int]]
  ##     i: seq[a, (s, t: int)]
  ##     (j, k, l): int
  ##     (m, n): (char, float)
  ##     o: seq[a, string]
  ##     (p): int
  ##     q: seq[int]; it.sorted(system.cmp)
  ##     r: seq[float]; it.sorted(cmp).filterIt(it > 0)
  ##     s: seq[char]
  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]
  ##     u: string; parseInt(it); abs(-it)
  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)
  ##     (w, x): tuple[a, b: char]
  ##     y: int; "hoge"

  expectKind(body, nnkStmtList)
  result = newTree(nnkStmtList)
  var letSection = newTree(nnkLetSection)
  for decl in body:
    case decl[0].kind:
      of nnkIdent: # x: ...
        letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      of nnkPar:
        expectMinLen(decl[0], 1)
        if decl[0].len == 1: # (x): ... これは x: ... と同じ扱いにしたい
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0][0], decl[1]))
        else: # (x, y, ...): ...
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      else:
        expectKind(decl[0], {nnkIdent, nnkPar})

  result.add(letSection)

# ほんとうは base1, base2 とかにしたかったんだけど template による数字の identifier としての連結が
# 0.19.0 以降からの機能だったので A, B, C, ... にした
type
  RollingHash* = object
    baseA, baseB: int
    mA, mB: int # modA, modB にしたかったんだけど initRollingHashMemberX の都合によりこうなった
    hashesA, hashesB: seq[int] # ハッシュ値（hashesX[i] = str[0..<i] のハッシュ値）
    powA, powB: seq[int] # powX[i] = baseX^i
  RollingHashRef* = ref RollingHash
  RollingHashTypes = RollingHash | RollingHashRef

# initImpl
template initRollingHashMemberX(self: var RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; s: string) =
  self.`pow X`[0] = 1
  for i, _ in s: self.`hashes X`[i + 1] = (self.`hashes X`[i] * self.`base X` + s[i].ord) mod self.`m X`
  for i, _ in s: self.`pow X`[i + 1] = (self.`pow X`[i] * self.`base X`) mod self.`m X`
proc initRollingHashTypesImpl(self: var RollingHashTypes; s: string) =
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(A, s)
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(B, s)

# init
# newSeq は 0.18.0 以上なら newSeqUninitialized を使いたい
proc initRollingHash*(s: string;
                      baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039;
                      mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097): RollingHash =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHash(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB,
                       mA: mA, mB: mB,
                       hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len),
                       powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)
proc newRollingHash*(s: string;
                     baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039;
                     mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097): RollingHashRef =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHashRef(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB,
                          mA: mA, mB: mB,
                          hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len),
                          powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)

# hash
template hashX(self: RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; l, r: SomeInteger): int =
  var result = self.`hashes X`[r] - self.`hashes X`[l] * self.`pow X`[r - l] mod self.`m X`
  if result < 0: result += self.`m X`
  result
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; l, r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = (self.hashX(A, l, r), self.hashX(B, l, r)) # [l, r)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; x: Slice[SomeInteger]): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = self.hash(x.a, x.b + 1)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = (self.hashesA[r], self.hashesB[r])

# 2分探索で LCP を求める
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, rs, lo, ro: SomeInteger): int = # self の文字列の [ls, rs) と other の文字列の [lo, ro) の LCP
  let len = min(rs - ls, ro - lo)
  var L = 0
  var R = len
  while R - L > 1:
    let M = (L + R) shr 1
    if self.hash(ls, ls + M) == other.hash(lo, lo + M): L = M
    else: R = M
  return L
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; sx, ox: Slice[SomeInteger]): int = LCP(self, other, sx.a, sx.b + 1, ox.a, ox.b + 1)
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, lo: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, other, ls, self.hashesA.len, lo, other.hashesA.len)
proc LCP*(self: RollingHashTypes; a, b: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, self, a, b) # S = self の文字列; S[a..^1] と S[b..^1] の LCP

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))
      else:
        error("変な入力があるよ")

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み

  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)
  ##     d: tuple[x: char, y: float]
  ##     e: (u, v: BiggestInt)
  ##     f: tuple[u, v: int]
  ##     g: seq[int]
  ##     h: seq[a, seq[int]]
  ##     i: seq[a, (s, t: int)]
  ##     (j, k, l): int
  ##     (m, n): (char, float)
  ##     o: seq[a, string]
  ##     (p): int
  ##     q: seq[int]; it.sorted(system.cmp)
  ##     r: seq[float]; it.sorted(cmp).filterIt(it > 0)
  ##     s: seq[char]
  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]
  ##     u: string; parseInt(it); abs(-it)
  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)
  ##     (w, x): tuple[a, b: char]
  ##     y: int; "hoge"

  expectKind(body, nnkStmtList)
  result = newTree(nnkStmtList)
  var letSection = newTree(nnkLetSection)
  for decl in body:
    case decl[0].kind:
      of nnkIdent: # x: ...
        letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      of nnkPar:
        expectMinLen(decl[0], 1)
        if decl[0].len == 1: # (x): ... これは x: ... と同じ扱いにしたい
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0][0], decl[1]))
        else: # (x, y, ...): ...
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      else:
        expectKind(decl[0], {nnkIdent, nnkPar})

type
  RollingHash* = object
    baseA, baseB: int
    mA, mB: int # modA, modB にしたかったんだけど initRollingHashMemberX の都合によりこうなった
    hashesA, hashesB: seq[int] # ハッシュ値（hashesX[i] = str[0..<i] のハッシュ値）
    powA, powB: seq[int] # powX[i] = baseX^i
  RollingHashRef* = ref RollingHash
  RollingHashTypes = RollingHash | RollingHashRef

# initImpl
template initRollingHashMemberX(self: var RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; s: string) =
  self.`pow X`[0] = 1
  for i, _ in s: self.`hashes X`[i + 1] = (self.`hashes X`[i] * self.`base X` + s[i].ord) mod self.`m X`
  for i, _ in s: self.`pow X`[i + 1] = (self.`pow X`[i] * self.`base X`) mod self.`m X`
proc initRollingHashTypesImpl(self: var RollingHashTypes; s: string) =
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(A, s)
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(B, s)

# init
# newSeq は 0.18.0 以上なら newSeqUninitialized を使いたい
proc initRollingHash*(s: string;
                      baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039;
                      mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097): RollingHash =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHash(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB,
                       mA: mA, mB: mB,
                       hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len),
                       powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)
proc newRollingHash*(s: string;
                     baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039;
                     mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097): RollingHashRef =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHashRef(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB,
                          mA: mA, mB: mB,
                          hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len),
                          powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)

# hash
template hashX(self: RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; l, r: SomeInteger): int =
  var result = self.`hashes X`[r] - self.`hashes X`[l] * self.`pow X`[r - l] mod self.`m X`
  if result < 0: result += self.`m X`
  result
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; l, r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = (self.hashX(A, l, r), self.hashX(B, l, r)) # [l, r)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; x: Slice[SomeInteger]): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = self.hash(x.a, x.b + 1)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = (self.hashesA[r], self.hashesB[r])

# 2分探索で LCP を求める
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, rs, lo, ro: SomeInteger): int = # self の文字列の [ls, rs) と other の文字列の [lo, ro) の LCP
  let len = min(rs - ls, ro - lo)
  var L = 0
  var R = len
  while R - L > 1:
    let M = (L + R) shr 1
    if self.hash(ls, ls + M) == other.hash(lo, lo + M): L = M
    else: R = M
  return L
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; sx, ox: Slice[SomeInteger]): int = LCP(self, other, sx.a, sx.b + 1, ox.a, ox.b + 1)
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, lo: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, other, ls, self.hashesA.len, lo, other.hashesA.len)
proc LCP*(self: RollingHashTypes; a, b: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, self, a, b) # S = self の文字列; S[a..^1] と S[b..^1] の LCP

# {{{ FastRollingHashOp
type FastRollingHashOpBase[MASK30:static[uint], MASK31:static[uint], MOD:static[uint], MASK61:static[uint]] = object
  discard
type FastRollingHashOp = FastRollingHashOpBase[(1'u shl 30) - 1, (1'u shl 31) - 1, (1'u shl 61) - 1, (1'u shl 61) - 1]

# a*b mod 2^61-1を返す関数(最後にModを取る)
proc multRaw(T:typedesc[FastRollingHashOp], a, b:uint):uint =
  let
    au = a shr 31
    ad = a and T.MASK31
    bu = b shr 31
    bd = b and T.MASK31
    mid = ad * bu + au * bd
    midu = mid shr 30
    midd = mid and T.MASK30
  return au * bu * 2 + midu + (midd shl 31) + ad * bd

# mod 2^61-1を計算する関数
proc calcMod(T:typedesc[FastRollingHashOp], x:uint):uint =
  let
    xu = x shr 61
    xd = x and T.MASK61
  result = xu + xd
  if result >= T.MOD: result -= T.MOD

proc mult(T:typedesc[FastRollingHashOp], a, b:uint):uint =
  return T.calcMod(T.multRaw(a, b))

type RollingHash[T] = object
  hashed, power: seq[uint]

proc initRollingHashCustom[T](s:string, base = 10007'u):RollingHash[T] =
  var
    sz = s.len
    hashed = newSeqWith(sz + 1, 0'u)
    power = newSeqWith(sz + 1, 0'u)
  power[0] = 1'u
  for i in 0..<sz:
    power[i + 1] = T.mult(power[i], base)
    hashed[i + 1] = T.calcMod(T.multRaw(hashed[i], base) + uint(s[i].ord))
#    if hashed[i + 1] >= MOD: hashed[i + 1] -= MOD
  return RollingHash[T](hashed: hashed, power: power)

proc initRollingHash(s:string):auto = initRollingHashCustom[FastRollingHashOp](s)

proc get[T](self: RollingHash[T]; s:Slice[int]):uint =
  result = self.hashed[s.b+1] + (T.MOD shl 2) - T.mul(self.hashed[s.a], self.power[s.b-s.a+1])
  if result >= T.MOD: result -= T.MOD

proc connect[T](self: RollingHash[T]; h1, h2:uint, h2len:int):uint =
  result = T.mul(h1, self.power[h2len]) + h2
  if result >= T.MOD: result -= T.MOD

proc LCP[T](self, b:RollingHash[T]; p1, p2:Slice[int]):int =
  var
    len = min(p1.len, p2.len)
    low = -1
    high = len + 1
  while high - low > 1:
    let mid = (low + high) div 2
    if self.get(p1.a..<p1.a + mid) == b.get(p2.a..<p2.a + mid): low = mid
    else: high = mid
  return low

  result = RH(self.hashed[s.b+1].h + (T.MOD shl 2) - multRaw(self.hashed[s.a], self.power[s.b-s.a+1]).h)
  result = result.calcMod()

proc connect(self: RollingHash; h1, h2:uint, h2len:int):RH =
  result = multRaw(RH(h1), self.power[h2len]) + RH(h2)
  result = result.calcMod

proc LCP(self, b:RollingHash; p1, p2:Slice[int]):int =
  var
    len = min(p1.len, p2.len)
    low = -1
    high = len + 1
  while high - low > 1:

    if self.get(p1.a..<p1.a + mid) == b.get(p2.a..<p2.a + mid): low = mid
    else: high = mid
  return low

proc parseT(s: string; T: typedesc): auto =
  ## `parse` 系関数のジェネリック版
  ## `T` が `SomeOrdinal | SomeFloat` (subranges を含む) でない場合，そのまま `s` を返す
  runnableExamples:
    doAssert parseT("12", int) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", uint) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", int64) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", float32) == 12.0
    doAssert parseT("Yes", bool) == true

  when T is SomeSignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestInt(s))
  elif T is SomeUnsignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestUInt(s))
  elif T is SomeFloat: cast[T](parseFloat(s))
  elif T is enum: parseEnum[T](s)
  elif T is bool: parseBool(s)
  elif T is char: s[0]
  else: s

proc unpackWithParse*(input: openArray[string]; T: typedesc[tuple]): T =
  ## 文字列配列を `T` で指定された `tuple` に `parse` しながら変換する
  runnableExamples:
    let t = unpackWithParse(@["1", "1", "1", "1", "1"], 4, tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool])
    doAssert int8 is t.a.type and t.a == 1
    doAssert uint32 is t.b.type and t.b == 1
    doAssert float64 is t.c.type and t.c == 1.0
    doAssert bool is t.d.type and t.d == true
    doAssert tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool] is t.type

  var i = 0
  for x in result.fields:
    if i > input.high:
      warn "元の配列の長さが " & $T.arity & " 未満だから，一部デフォルト値になってるよ"
      break
    x = parseT(input[i], x.type)
    i.inc
  result

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))
      else:
        error("変な入力があるよ")

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  ## 入力を受け取る
  ## 宣言の後に `it` を用いた式を（`y` みたいに用いなくてもいいんだけど）いくつでもかくことができ，
  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)
  ##     d: tuple[x: char, y: float]
  ##     e: (u, v: BiggestInt)
  ##     f: tuple[u, v: int]
  ##     g: seq[int]
  ##     h: seq[a, seq[int]]
  ##     i: seq[a, (s, t: int)]
  ##     (j, k, l): int
  ##     (m, n): (char, float)
  ##     o: seq[a, string]
  ##     (p): int
  ##     q: seq[int]; it.sorted(system.cmp)
  ##     r: seq[float]; it.sorted(cmp).filterIt(it > 0)
  ##     s: seq[char]
  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]
  ##     u: string; parseInt(it); abs(-it)
  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)
  ##     (w, x): tuple[a, b: char]
  ##     y: int; "hoge"

  expectKind(body, nnkStmtList)
  result = newTree(nnkStmtList)
  var letSection = newTree(nnkLetSection)
  for decl in body:
    case decl[0].kind:
      of nnkIdent: # x: ...
        letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      of nnkPar:
        expectMinLen(decl[0], 1)
        if decl[0].len == 1: # (x): ... これは x: ... と同じ扱いにしたい
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0][0], decl[1]))
        else: # (x, y, ...): ...
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      else:
        expectKind(decl[0], {nnkIdent, nnkPar})

  result.add(letSection)

# このテキトーな実装が嫌になったとき用の参考
# https://www.slideshare.net/nagisaeto/rolling-hash-149990902?ref=https://cards-frame.twitter.com/i/cards/tfw/v1/uc/1173504502827106305


# ほんとうは base1, base2 とかにしたかったんだけど template による数字の identifier としての連結が
# 0.19.0 以降からの機能だったので A, B, C, ... にした
type
  RollingHash* = object
    baseA, baseB, baseC: int
    mA, mB, mC: int # modA, modB にしたかったんだけど initRollingHashMemberX の都合によりこうなった
    hashesA, hashesB, hashesC: seq[int] # ハッシュ値（hashesX[i] = str[0..<i] のハッシュ値）
    powA, powB, powC: seq[int] # powX[i] = baseX^i
  RollingHashRef* = ref RollingHash
  RollingHashTypes = RollingHash | RollingHashRef

# initImpl
template initRollingHashMemberX(self: var RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; s: string) =
  self.`pow X`[0] = 1
  for i, _ in s: self.`hashes X`[i + 1] = (self.`hashes X`[i] * self.`base X` + s[i].ord) mod self.`m X`
  for i, _ in s: self.`pow X`[i + 1] = (self.`pow X`[i] * self.`base X`) mod self.`m X`
proc initRollingHashTypesImpl(self: var RollingHashTypes; s: string) =
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(A, s)
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(B, s)
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(C, s)

# init
# newSeq は 0.18.0 以上なら newSeqUninitialized を使いたい
proc initRollingHash*(s: string;
                      baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039, baseC: int = 3039;
                      mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097; mC: int = 1000000009): RollingHash =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHash(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB, baseC: baseC,
                       mA: mA, mB: mB, mC: mC,
                       hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len), hashesC: newSeq[int](len),
                       powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len), powC: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)

# hash
template hashX(self: RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; l, r: SomeInteger): int =
  var result = self.`hashes X`[r] - self.`hashes X`[l] * self.`pow X`[r - l] mod self.`m X`
  if result < 0: result += self.`m X`
  result
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; l, r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB, hashC: int] = (self.hashX(A, l, r), self.hashX(B, l, r), self.hashX(C, l, r)) # [l, r)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; x: Slice[SomeInteger]): tuple[hashA, hashB, hashC: int] = self.hash(x.a, x.b + 1)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB, hashC: int] = (self.hashesA[r], self.hashesB[r])

# 2分探索で LCP を求める
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, rs, lo, ro: SomeInteger): int = # self の文字列の [ls, rs) と other の文字列の [lo, ro) の LCP
  let len = min(rs - ls, ro - lo)
  var L = 0
  var R = len
  while R - L > 1:
    let M = (L + R) shr 1
    if self.hash(ls, ls + M) == other.hash(lo, lo + M): L = M
    else: R = M
  return L
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; sx, ox: Slice[SomeInteger]): int = LCP(self, other, sx.a, sx.b + 1, ox.a, ox.b + 1)
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, lo: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, other, ls, self.hashesA.len, lo, other.hashesA.len)
proc LCP*(self: RollingHashTypes; a, b: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, self, a, b) # S = self の文字列; S[a..^1] と S[b..^1] の LCP

proc parseT(s: string; T: typedesc): auto =
  ## `parse` 系関数のジェネリック版
  ## `T` が `SomeOrdinal | SomeFloat` (subranges を含む) でない場合，そのまま `s` を返す
  runnableExamples:
    doAssert parseT("12", int) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", uint) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", int64) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", float32) == 12.0
    doAssert parseT("Yes", bool) == true

  when T is SomeSignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestInt(s))
  elif T is SomeUnsignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestUInt(s))
  elif T is SomeFloat: cast[T](parseFloat(s))
  elif T is enum: parseEnum[T](s)
  elif T is bool: parseBool(s)
  elif T is char: s[0]
  else: s

proc unpackWithParse*(input: openArray[string]; T: typedesc[tuple]): T =
  ## 文字列配列を `T` で指定された `tuple` に `parse` しながら変換する
  runnableExamples:
    let t = unpackWithParse(@["1", "1", "1", "1", "1"], 4, tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool])
    doAssert int8 is t.a.type and t.a == 1
    doAssert uint32 is t.b.type and t.b == 1
    doAssert float64 is t.c.type and t.c == 1.0
    doAssert bool is t.d.type and t.d == true
    doAssert tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool] is t.type

  var i = 0
  for x in result.fields:
    if i > input.high:
      warn "元の配列の長さが " & $T.arity & " 未満だから，一部デフォルト値になってるよ"
      break
    x = parseT(input[i], x.type)
    i.inc
  result

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))
      else:
        error("変な入力があるよ")

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  ## 入力を受け取る
  ## 宣言の後に `it` を用いた式を（`y` みたいに用いなくてもいいんだけど）いくつでもかくことができ，
  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)
  ##     d: tuple[x: char, y: float]
  ##     e: (u, v: BiggestInt)
  ##     f: tuple[u, v: int]
  ##     g: seq[int]
  ##     h: seq[a, seq[int]]
  ##     i: seq[a, (s, t: int)]
  ##     (j, k, l): int
  ##     (m, n): (char, float)
  ##     o: seq[a, string]
  ##     (p): int
  ##     q: seq[int]; it.sorted(system.cmp)
  ##     r: seq[float]; it.sorted(cmp).filterIt(it > 0)
  ##     s: seq[char]
  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]
  ##     u: string; parseInt(it); abs(-it)
  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)
  ##     (w, x): tuple[a, b: char]
  ##     y: int; "hoge"

  expectKind(body, nnkStmtList)
  result = newTree(nnkStmtList)
  var letSection = newTree(nnkLetSection)
  for decl in body:
    case decl[0].kind:
      of nnkIdent: # x: ...
        letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      of nnkPar:
        expectMinLen(decl[0], 1)
        if decl[0].len == 1: # (x): ... これは x: ... と同じ扱いにしたい
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0][0], decl[1]))
        else: # (x, y, ...): ...
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      else:
        expectKind(decl[0], {nnkIdent, nnkPar})

  result.add(letSection)

template newSeqWithImpl[T](lens: seq[int]; init: T; currentDimension, lensLen: static[int]): untyped =
  when currentDimension == lensLen:
    newSeqWith(lens[currentDimension - 1], init)
  else:
    newSeqWith(lens[currentDimension - 1], newSeqWithImpl(lens, init, currentDimension + 1, lensLen))

  assert(lens.allIt(it > 0))
  newSeqWithImpl(@lens, init, 1, lens.len)
