# 何しても衝突するんじゃないかと思ったので，2種類定数でとるのでいいかなって
# このテキトーな実装が嫌になったとき用の参考
# https://www.slideshare.net/nagisaeto/rolling-hash-149990902?ref=https://cards-frame.twitter.com/i/cards/tfw/v1/uc/1173504502827106305


# ほんとうは base1, base2 とかにしたかったんだけど template による数字の identifier としての連結が
# 0.19.0 以降からの機能だったので A, B, C, ... にした
type
  RollingHash* = object
    baseA, baseB: int
    mA, mB: int # modA, modB にしたかったんだけど initRollingHashMemberX の都合によりこうなった
    hashesA, hashesB: seq[int] # ハッシュ値（hashesX[i] = str[0..<i] のハッシュ値）
    powA, powB: seq[int] # powX[i] = baseX^i
  RollingHashRef* = ref RollingHash
  RollingHashTypes = RollingHash | RollingHashRef

# initImpl
template initRollingHashMemberX(self: var RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; s: string) =
  self.`pow X`[0] = 1
  for i, _ in s: self.`hashes X`[i + 1] = (self.`hashes X`[i] * self.`base X` + s[i].ord) mod self.`m X`
  for i, _ in s: self.`pow X`[i + 1] = (self.`pow X`[i] * self.`base X`) mod self.`m X`
proc initRollingHashTypesImpl(self: var RollingHashTypes; s: string) =
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(A, s)
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(B, s)

# init
# newSeq は 0.18.0 以上なら newSeqUninitialized を使いたい
proc initRollingHash*(s: string;
                      baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039;
                      mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097): RollingHash =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHash(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB,
                       mA: mA, mB: mB,
                       hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len),
                       powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)
proc newRollingHash*(s: string;
                     baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039;
                     mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097): RollingHashRef =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHashRef(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB,
                          mA: mA, mB: mB,
                          hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len),
                          powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)

# hash
template hashX(self: RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; l, r: SomeInteger): int =
  var result = self.`hashes X`[r] - self.`hashes X`[l] * self.`pow X`[r - l] mod self.`m X`
  if result < 0: result += self.`m X`
  result
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; l, r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = (self.hashX(A, l, r), self.hashX(B, l, r)) # [l, r)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; x: Slice[SomeInteger]): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = self.hash(x.a, x.b + 1)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = (self.hashesA[r], self.hashesB[r])

# 2分探索で LCP を求める
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, rs, lo, ro: SomeInteger): int = # self の文字列の [ls, rs) と other の文字列の [lo, ro) の LCP
  let len = min(rs - ls, ro - lo)
  var L = 0
  var R = len
  while R - L > 1:
    let M = (L + R) shr 1
    if self.hash(ls, ls + M) == other.hash(lo, lo + M): L = M
    else: R = M
  return L
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; sx, ox: Slice[SomeInteger]): int = LCP(self, other, sx.a, sx.b + 1, ox.a, ox.b + 1)
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, lo: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, other, ls, self.hashesA.len, lo, other.hashesA.len)
proc LCP*(self: RollingHashTypes; a, b: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, self, a, b) # S = self の文字列; S[a..^1] と S[b..^1] の LCP

include std/critbits
from std/strutils import delete

inputs:
  N: int
  S: seq[N, string]; it.mapIt(it.reversed)

var T: CritBitTree[void]
for s in S:
  T.incl(s)

var result = 0
for s in S:
  var suffix: set[char]
  var s = s
  while true:
    suffix.incl(s[^1])
    s.delete(s.high, s.high)
    let node = T.allprefixedAux(key = s, longestMatch = false)
    for nextNode in leaves(node):
      if nextNode.isLeaf and nextNode.key.len == s.len + 1 and nextNode.key[^1] in suffix:
        result.inc
    if s.len == 0: break

echo result - N

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  ## 入力を受け取る
  ## 宣言の後に `it` を用いた式を（`y` みたいに用いなくてもいいんだけど）いくつでもかくことができ，
  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）

  ## .. code-block:: Nim

  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)

# 何しても衝突するんじゃないかと思ったので，2種類定数でとるのでいいかなって
# このテキトーな実装が嫌になったとき用の参考
# https://www.slideshare.net/nagisaeto/rolling-hash-149990902?ref=https://cards-frame.twitter.com/i/cards/tfw/v1/uc/1173504502827106305


# ほんとうは base1, base2 とかにしたかったんだけど template による数字の identifier としての連結が
# 0.19.0 以降からの機能だったので A, B, C, ... にした
type
  RollingHash* = object
    baseA, baseB, baseC: int
    mA, mB, mC: int # modA, modB にしたかったんだけど initRollingHashMemberX の都合によりこうなった
    hashesA, hashesB, hashesC: seq[int] # ハッシュ値（hashesX[i] = str[0..<i] のハッシュ値）
    powA, powB, powC: seq[int] # powX[i] = baseX^i
  RollingHashRef* = ref RollingHash
  RollingHashTypes = RollingHash | RollingHashRef

# initImpl
template initRollingHashMemberX(self: var RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; s: string) =
  self.`pow X`[0] = 1
  for i, _ in s: self.`hashes X`[i + 1] = (self.`hashes X`[i] * self.`base X` + s[i].ord) mod self.`m X`
  for i, _ in s: self.`pow X`[i + 1] = (self.`pow X`[i] * self.`base X`) mod self.`m X`
proc initRollingHashTypesImpl(self: var RollingHashTypes; s: string) =
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(A, s)
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(B, s)
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(C, s)

# init
# newSeq は 0.18.0 以上なら newSeqUninitialized を使いたい
proc initRollingHash*(s: string;
                      baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039, baseC: int = 3037;
                      mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097; mC: int = 1000000009): RollingHash =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHash(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB, baseC: baseC,
                       mA: mA, mB: mB, mC: mC,
                       hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len), hashesC: newSeq[int](len),
                       powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len), powC: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)

# hash
template hashX(self: RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; l, r: SomeInteger): int =
  var result = self.`hashes X`[r] - self.`hashes X`[l] * self.`pow X`[r - l] mod self.`m X`
  if result < 0: result += self.`m X`
  result
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; l, r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB, hashC: int] = (self.hashX(A, l, r), self.hashX(B, l, r), self.hashX(C, l, r)) # [l, r)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; x: Slice[SomeInteger]): tuple[hashA, hashB, hashC: int] = self.hash(x.a, x.b + 1)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB, hashC: int] = (self.hashesA[r], self.hashesB[r])

# 2分探索で LCP を求める
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, rs, lo, ro: SomeInteger): int = # self の文字列の [ls, rs) と other の文字列の [lo, ro) の LCP
  let len = min(rs - ls, ro - lo)
  var L = 0
  var R = len
  while R - L > 1:
    let M = (L + R) shr 1
    if self.hash(ls, ls + M) == other.hash(lo, lo + M): L = M
    else: R = M
  return L
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; sx, ox: Slice[SomeInteger]): int = LCP(self, other, sx.a, sx.b + 1, ox.a, ox.b + 1)
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, lo: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, other, ls, self.hashesA.len, lo, other.hashesA.len)
proc LCP*(self: RollingHashTypes; a, b: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, self, a, b) # S = self の文字列; S[a..^1] と S[b..^1] の LCP

proc parseT(s: string; T: typedesc): auto =
  ## `parse` 系関数のジェネリック版
  ## `T` が `SomeOrdinal | SomeFloat` (subranges を含む) でない場合，そのまま `s` を返す
  runnableExamples:
    doAssert parseT("12", int) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", uint) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", int64) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", float32) == 12.0
    doAssert parseT("Yes", bool) == true

  when T is SomeSignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestInt(s))
  elif T is SomeUnsignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestUInt(s))
  elif T is SomeFloat: cast[T](parseFloat(s))
  elif T is enum: parseEnum[T](s)
  elif T is bool: parseBool(s)
  elif T is char: s[0]
  else: s

proc unpackWithParse*(input: openArray[string]; T: typedesc[tuple]): T =
  ## 文字列配列を `T` で指定された `tuple` に `parse` しながら変換する
  runnableExamples:
    let t = unpackWithParse(@["1", "1", "1", "1", "1"], 4, tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool])
    doAssert int8 is t.a.type and t.a == 1
    doAssert uint32 is t.b.type and t.b == 1
    doAssert float64 is t.c.type and t.c == 1.0
    doAssert bool is t.d.type and t.d == true
    doAssert tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool] is t.type

  var i = 0
  for x in result.fields:
    if i > input.high:
      warn "元の配列の長さが " & $T.arity & " 未満だから，一部デフォルト値になってるよ"
      break
    x = parseT(input[i], x.type)
    i.inc
  result

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))
      else:
        error("変な入力があるよ")

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int

type
  RollingHash* = object
    baseA, baseB: int
    mA, mB: int # modA, modB にしたかったんだけど initRollingHashMemberX の都合によりこうなった
    hashesA, hashesB: seq[int] # ハッシュ値（hashesX[i] = str[0..<i] のハッシュ値）
    powA, powB: seq[int] # powX[i] = baseX^i
  RollingHashRef* = ref RollingHash
  RollingHashTypes = RollingHash | RollingHashRef

# initImpl
template initRollingHashMemberX(self: var RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; s: string) =
  self.`pow X`[0] = 1
  for i, _ in s: self.`hashes X`[i + 1] = (self.`hashes X`[i] * self.`base X` + s[i].ord) mod self.`m X`
  for i, _ in s: self.`pow X`[i + 1] = (self.`pow X`[i] * self.`base X`) mod self.`m X`
proc initRollingHashTypesImpl(self: var RollingHashTypes; s: string) =
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(A, s)
  self.initRollingHashMemberX(B, s)

# init
# newSeq は 0.18.0 以上なら newSeqUninitialized を使いたい
proc initRollingHash*(s: string;
                      baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039;
                      mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097): RollingHash =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHash(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB,
                       mA: mA, mB: mB,
                       hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len),
                       powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)
proc newRollingHash*(s: string;
                     baseA: int = 1039, baseB: int = 2039;
                     mA: int = 999999929, mB: int = 1000000097): RollingHashRef =
  let len = s.len + 1
  result = RollingHashRef(baseA: baseA, baseB: baseB,
                          mA: mA, mB: mB,
                          hashesA: newSeq[int](len), hashesB: newSeq[int](len),
                          powA: newSeq[int](len), powB: newSeq[int](len))
  result.initRollingHashTypesImpl(s)

# hash
template hashX(self: RollingHashTypes; X: untyped; l, r: SomeInteger): int =
  var result = self.`hashes X`[r] - self.`hashes X`[l] * self.`pow X`[r - l] mod self.`m X`
  if result < 0: result += self.`m X`
  result
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; l, r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = (self.hashX(A, l, r), self.hashX(B, l, r)) # [l, r)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; x: Slice[SomeInteger]): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = self.hash(x.a, x.b + 1)
proc hash*(self: RollingHashTypes; r: SomeInteger): tuple[hashA, hashB: int] = (self.hashesA[r], self.hashesB[r])

# 2分探索で LCP を求める
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, rs, lo, ro: SomeInteger): int = # self の文字列の [ls, rs) と other の文字列の [lo, ro) の LCP
  let len = min(rs - ls, ro - lo)
  var L = 0
  var R = len
  while R - L > 1:
    let M = (L + R) shr 1
    if self.hash(ls, ls + M) == other.hash(lo, lo + M): L = M
    else: R = M
  return L
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; sx, ox: Slice[SomeInteger]): int = LCP(self, other, sx.a, sx.b + 1, ox.a, ox.b + 1)
proc LCP*(self, other: RollingHashTypes; ls, lo: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, other, ls, self.hashesA.len, lo, other.hashesA.len)
proc LCP*(self: RollingHashTypes; a, b: SomeInteger): int = LCP(self, self, a, b) # S = self の文字列; S[a..^1] と S[b..^1] の LCP

# {{{ FastRollingHashOp
template MASK(n:static[int]):auto = (1'u shl n.uint) - 1

const base = 1000000007'u

type RH_Base[Mod:static[uint], base:static[uint]] = object
  h:uint

type RH = RH_Base[(1'u shl 61) - 1, base]

converter toRH(t:SomeInteger or char):RH = RH(h:t.uint)

proc multRaw(a, b:RH):RH =
  let
    au = a.h shr 31
    ad = a.h and MASK(31)
    bu = b.h shr 31
    bd = b.h and MASK(31)
    mid = ad * bu + au * bd
    midu = mid shr 30
    midd = mid and MASK(30)
  RH(h:au * bu * 2 + midu + (midd shl 31) + ad * bd)

proc calcMod[T:RH](x:T):T =
  let
    xu = x.h shr 61
    xd = x.h and MASK(61)
  result = RH(xu + xd)
  if result.h >= T.Mod: result.h -= T.Mod

proc `*=`(a: var RH, b:RH) =  a = calcMod(multRaw(a, b))
proc `*`(a, b:RH):RH = result = a;result *= b
proc `==`(a, b:RH):bool = a.h == b.h
proc `+=`(a:var RH, b:RH) =
  a.h += b.h
  if a.h >= RH.Mod: a.h -= RH.Mod
proc `+`(a, b:RH):RH = result = a;result += b
proc `-=`(a:var RH, b:RH) =
  a.h += RH.Mod - b.h
  if a.h >= RH.Mod: a.h -= RH.Mod
proc `-`(a, b:RH):RH = result = a;result -= b
proc `&=`(a:var RH, c:SomeInteger or char) =
  a = multRaw(a, RH(base))
  a += RH(c)
  a = a.calcMod()
proc `&`(a:RH, c:SomeInteger or char):RH = result = a;result &= c

type RollingHash[RH] = object
  hashed, power: seq[RH]

proc initRollingHashCustom(s:string):auto =
  var
    sz = s.len
    hashed = newSeqWith(sz + 1, RH(0))
    power = newSeqWith(sz + 1, RH(0))
  power[0] = 1'u
  for i in 0..<sz:
    power[i + 1] = RH(power[i]) * RH(base)
    hashed[i + 1] = calcMod(multRaw(hashed[i], RH(base)) + RH(s[i]))
#    if hashed[i + 1] >= MOD: hashed[i + 1] -= MOD
  return RollingHash[RH](hashed: hashed, power: power)

proc get[T:RH](self: RollingHash; s:Slice[int]):T =
  result = RH(self.hashed[s.b+1].h + (T.MOD shl 2) - multRaw(self.hashed[s.a], self.power[s.b-s.a+1]).h)
  result = result.calcMod()

proc connect(self: RollingHash; h1, h2:uint, h2len:int):RH =
  result = multRaw(RH(h1), self.power[h2len]) + RH(h2)
  result = result.calcMod

proc LCP(self, b:RollingHash; p1, p2:Slice[int]):int =
  var
    len = min(p1.len, p2.len)
    low = -1
    high = len + 1
  while high - low > 1:
    let mid = (low + high) div 2
    if self.get(p1.a..<p1.a + mid) == b.get(p2.a..<p2.a + mid): low = mid
    else: high = mid
  return low

class rh:#base,max_n=ありうる文字の最大長,convertを指定すること
    def __init__(self,base,max_n):#baseとmaxnを指定すること。baseは偶数(modが奇数)
        self.mod=random.randrange(1<<54-1,1<<55-1,2)#奇数、衝突させられないよう乱数で生成
        self.base=int(base*0.5+0.5)*2#偶数,英小文字なら26とか
        self.max_n=max_n

        cur1=1
        for i in range(1,max_n+1):
            cur1=cur1*base%self.mod
            self.pows1[i]=cur1

    def convert(self,c): return alp2num(c,False)#大文字の場合Trueにする
    
    def get(self, s):#特定の文字のhash. O(|s|)
        n=len(s)
        mod=self.mod
        si=[self.convert(ss) for ss in s]
        h1=0
        for i in range(n):h1=(h1+si[i]*self.pows1[n-1-i])%mod
        return h1
    
    def get_roll(self, s, k, uroboros=False):#ローリングハッシュ,sの各文字を始点とした長さkの部分文字のhash値をすべて得る,O(|s|)
        #uroboros: trueの場合文字sを循環させ、n個のハッシュ値を得る。 falseの場合n-k+1個
        n=len(s)
        maxitr=n-k+1
        if uroboros: maxitr=n
    
        si=[self.convert(ss) for ss in s]
        mod=self.mod
        h1=0
        for i in range(k):h1=(h1+si[i%n]*self.pows1[k-1-i])%mod
        hs=[0]*maxitr
        hs[0]=h1
        mbase1=self.pows1[k]
        base=self.base
        
        for i in range(1,maxitr): 
            front=si[i-1];back=si[(i+k-1)%n]
            h1=(h1*base-front*mbase1+back)%mod
            hs[i]=h1
        return hs

MASK30 = (1 << 30) - 1
MASK31 = (1 << 31) - 1
MASK61 = (1 << 61) - 1

@njit((i8, ), cache=True)
def rh_modulo(x):
    xu, xd = x >> 61, x & MASK61
    x = xu + xd
    if x >= MASK61:
        x -= MASK61
    return x


@njit((i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_multiply(a, b):
    au, ad = a >> 31, a & MASK31
    bu, bd = b >> 31, b & MASK31
    x = ad * bu + au * bd
    xu, xd = x >> 30, x & MASK30
    return rh_modulo(au * bu * 2 + xu + (xd << 31) + ad * bd)


@njit((i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_pows(base, max_len):
    pows = np.empty(max_len, np.int64)
    pows[0] = 1
    for n in range(1, max_len):
        pows[n] = rh_multiply(pows[n - 1], base)
    return pows


@njit((i8[:], i8, i8[:]), cache=True)
def compute_rh(pows, base, S):
    N = len(S)
    RH = np.empty(N, np.int64)
    RH[0] = S[0] + 10
    for n in range(1, N):
        x = rh_multiply(RH[n - 1], base) + S[n] + 10
        if x >= MASK61:
            x -= MASK61
        RH[n] = x
    return RH


@njit((i8[:], i8, i8[:], i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_substr(pows, base, RH, l, r):
    h = RH[r]
    if l > 0:
        h -= rh_multiply(RH[l], pows[r - l])
    if h < 0:
        h += MASK61
    return h

@njit((i8[:], ), cache=True)
def main(S):
    S = S.copy()
    l_ind = np.where(S == -1)[0][:-1] + 1
    r_ind = np.where(S == -1)[0][1:]
    N = len(l_ind)
    # 逆順にしておく
    for i in range(N):
        S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]] = S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]][::-1]

    # rolling hashの計算
    max_len = len(S) + 10
    base = np.random.randint(0, 1 << 31)
    pows = rh_pows(base, max_len)
    RH = np.zeros_like(S)
    for i in range(N):
        RH[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]] = compute_rh(pows, base, S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]])

    # 後ろ（自身も含む）に置ける文字集合の計算
    sets = np.zeros_like(S)
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(r_ind[i] - 1, l_ind[i] - 1, -1):
            sets[j] = sets[j + 1] | 1 << S[j]

    # 作れる組 (prefix, 右からの1文字)をすべて計算する
    ptr = 0
    nums = np.empty(len(S) * 26 + 10, np.int64)
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(l_ind[i], r_ind[i]):
            for k in range(26):
                if sets[j] & 1 << k:
                    h = rh_multiply(RH[j - 1], base) + k
                    nums[ptr] = h
                    ptr += 1
    nums = nums[:ptr]
    nums.sort()
    # 各文字列とマッチングする対象を数える
    ans = 0
    for i in range(N):
        h = rh_multiply(RH[r_ind[i] - 2], base) + S[r_ind[i] - 1]
        cnt = np.searchsorted(nums, h, 'right')
        cnt -= np.searchsorted(nums, h, 'left')
        ans += cnt - 1  # 自分を除外
    print(ans)

def fact_and_inv(SIZE):
    inv = [0] * SIZE  # inv[j] = j^{-1} mod MOD
    fac = [0] * SIZE  # fac[j] = j! mod MOD
    finv = [0] * SIZE  # finv[j] = (j!)^{-1} mod MOD

    finv[0] = finv[1] = 1

class RollingHash:
    """文字列stringsの部分文字列のハッシュを構築する。O(N)"""
    def __init__(self, string):
        self.n = len(string)
        self.BASE = 1234
        self.MASK30 = (1 << 30) - 1
        self.MASK31 = (1 << 31) - 1
        self.MASK61 = (1 << 61) - 1
        self.MOD = self.MASK61
        self.hash = [0] * (self.n + 1)
        self.pow = [1] * (self.n + 1)

        for i, char in enumerate(string):
            self.hash[i + 1] = self.calc_mod(self.mul(self.hash[i], self.BASE)
                                             + ord(char))
            self.pow[i + 1] = self.calc_mod(self.mul(self.pow[i], self.BASE))

    def calc_mod(self, x):
        """x mod 2^61-1 を返す。"""
        xu = x >> 61
        xd = x & self.MASK61
        x = xu + xd
        if x >= self.MOD:
            x -= MASK61
        return x

    def mul(self, a, b):
        """a*b mod 2^61-1 を返す。"""
        au = a >> 31
        ad = a & self.MASK31
        bu = b >> 31
        bd = b & self.MASK31
        mid = ad * bu + au * bd
        midu = mid >> 30
        midd = mid & self.MASK30
        return self.calc_mod(au * bu * 2 + midu + (midd << 31) + ad * bd)

    def get_hash(self, l, r):
        """string[l:r]のハッシュ値を返す。O(1)"""
        res = self.calc_mod(self.hash[r]
                            - self.mul(self.hash[l], self.pow[r - l]))
        return res

    def merge(self, h1, h2, length2):
        """ハッシュ値h1と長さlength2のハッシュ値h2を結合する。O(1)"""
        return self.calc_mod(self.mul(h1, self.pow[length2]) + h2)

    def get_lcp(self, l1, r1, l2, r2):
        """string[l1:r2]とstring[l2:r2]の長共通接頭辞(Longest Common Prefix)の
        長さを求める。O(log|string|)
        """
        ng = min(r1 - l1, r2 - l2) + 1
        ok = 0
        while abs(ok - ng) > 1:
            mid = (ok + ng) // 2
            if self.get_hash(l1, l1 + mid) == self.get_hash(l2, l2 + mid):
                ok = mid
            else:
                ng = mid
        return ok

	def __init__(self, char):
		self.char = char
		self.children = [-1] * ALPHABET_SIZE
		self.flag = [0] * ALPHABET_SIZE

class Trie(object):
	def __init__(self):
		self.root = Node(' ')

	def _convert_char_to_num(self, char):
		return ord(char) - 97

	def insert(self, word, tail):
		res = 0 #合う値
		current = self.root
		currentFlag = [0] * ALPHABET_SIZE

		for char in word:
			char_index = self._convert_char_to_num(char)
			for i in range(ALPHABET_SIZE):
				currentFlag[i] += current.flag[i]
			res += currentFlag[char_index]
			currentFlag[char_index] = 0

			if current.children[char_index] != -1:
				current = current.children[char_index]

			else:
				new_node = Node(char)
				current.children[char_index] = new_node
				current = new_node

		char_index = self._convert_char_to_num(tail)
		res += currentFlag[char_index]

		current.flag[self._convert_char_to_num(tail)] += 1

		return res

class SegmentTree:
  def __init__(self, n, op, e):
    self.n = n
    self.op = op
    self.e = e
    self.size = 2 ** ((n - 1).bit_length())
    self.node = [self.e] * (2 * self.size)
 
  def build(self, array):
    for i in range(self.n):
      self.node[self.size + i] = array[i]
    for i in range(self.size - 1, 0, -1):
      self.node[i] = self.op(self.node[i << 1], self.node[(i << 1) + 1])
 
  def update(self, i, val):
    i += self.size
    self.node[i] += val
    while i > 1:
      i >>= 1
      self.node[i] = self.op(self.node[i << 1], self.node[(i << 1) + 1])
 
  def get(self, l, r):
    l, r = l + self.size, r + self.size
    res_l, res_r = self.e, self.e
    while l < r:
      if l & 1:
        res_l = self.op(res_l, self.node[l])
        l += 1
      if r & 1:
        r -= 1
        res_r = self.op(self.node[r], res_r) 
      l, r = l >> 1, r >> 1
    return self.op(res_l, res_r)

class TrieNode:

    item : 単語に登録するvalue, 単語終端ノード以外の場合はNone
    children : list 子ノードのリスト
    """

        self.item = item
        self.children = [-1 for i in range(VOCAB_SIZE)]

        ret = ret + "item = {}\n".format(self.item)

class Trie:
    def __init__(self):
        root = TrieNode()
        self.nodes = [root]

    def __add_node(self, node):
        self.nodes.append(node)
        return len(self.nodes) - 1

    def __get_char_num(self, c):
        #文字列の番号を返す関数
        return ord(c) - ord('a')

    def insert(self ,word, item):
        """Trieに新しい単語を登録する
        word : str 登録する単語
        item : wordに格納するvalue
        """
        char_index=0; node_index=0
        lw=len(word)
        for char_index in range(lw):
            char_num = self.__get_char_num(word[char_index])
            next_node_index = self.nodes[node_index].children[char_num]
            if next_node_index == -1:
                # 現在のノードにword[char_index]での遷移がなかった場合
                new_node = TrieNode()
                next_node_index = self.__add_node(new_node)
                self.nodes[node_index].children[char_num] = next_node_index
            node_index=next_node_index
            
        self.nodes[node_index].item = item

    def get_node(self, word):
        """
        検索
        word : str
        return : node.item or None
        """
        node_index = 0

        for c in word:
            char_num = self.__get_char_num(c)
            tmp_node = self.nodes[node_index]
            
            node_index = tmp_node.children[char_num]
            if node_index == -1:
                return None
        return self.nodes[node_index]


    def query(self, word):
        """
        検索
        word : str
        return : node.item or None
        """
        node_index = 0

        for c in word:
            char_num = self.__get_char_num(c)
            tmp_node = self.nodes[node_index]
            
            node_index = tmp_node.children[char_num]
            if node_index == -1:
                return None
        return node_index,self.nodes[node_index].item

class RollingHash:
    """文字列stringsの部分文字列のハッシュを構築する。O(N)"""
    def __init__(self, string):
        self.n = len(string)
        self.BASE = 1234
        self.MASK30 = (1 << 30) - 1
        self.MASK31 = (1 << 31) - 1
        self.MASK61 = (1 << 61) - 1
        self.MOD = self.MASK61
        self.hash = [0] * (self.n + 1)
        self.pow = [1] * (self.n + 1)

        for i, char in enumerate(string):
            self.hash[i + 1] = self.calc_mod(self.mul(self.hash[i], self.BASE)
                                             + ord(char))
            self.pow[i + 1] = self.calc_mod(self.mul(self.pow[i], self.BASE))

    def calc_mod(self, x):
        """x mod 2^61-1 を返す。"""
        xu = x >> 61
        xd = x & self.MASK61
        x = xu + xd
        if x >= self.MOD:
            x -= MASK61
        return x

    def mul(self, a, b):
        """a*b mod 2^61-1 を返す。"""
        au = a >> 31
        ad = a & self.MASK31
        bu = b >> 31
        bd = b & self.MASK31
        mid = ad * bu + au * bd
        midu = mid >> 30
        midd = mid & self.MASK30
        return self.calc_mod(au * bu * 2 + midu + (midd << 31) + ad * bd)

    def get_hash(self, l, r):
        """string[l:r]のハッシュ値を返す。O(1)"""
        res = self.calc_mod(self.hash[r]
                            - self.mul(self.hash[l], self.pow[r - l]))
        return res

    def merge(self, h1, h2, length2):
        """ハッシュ値h1と長さlength2のハッシュ値h2を結合する。O(1)"""
        return self.calc_mod(self.mul(h1, self.pow[length2]) + h2)

    def get_lcp(self, l1, r1, l2, r2):
        """string[l1:r2]とstring[l2:r2]の長共通接頭辞(Longest Common Prefix)の
        長さを求める。O(log|string|)
        """
        ng = min(r1 - l1, r2 - l2) + 1
        ok = 0
        while abs(ok - ng) > 1:
            mid = (ok + ng) // 2
            if self.get_hash(l1, l1 + mid) == self.get_hash(l2, l2 + mid):
                ok = mid
            else:
                ng = mid
        return ok

def main(S):
    S = S.copy()
    l_ind = np.where(S == -1)[0][:-1] + 1
    r_ind = np.where(S == -1)[0][1:]

    # 逆順にしておく
    N = len(l_ind)
    for i in range(N):
        S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]] = S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]][::-1]

    # Trie木の構築
    path = np.zeros_like(S)
    child = np.zeros((len(S), 26), np.int64)
    is_end = np.zeros(len(S), np.bool_)

    n_node = 1
    for i in range(N):
        node = 0
        for j in range(l_ind[i], r_ind[i]):
            path[j] = node
            if child[node][S[j]] == 0:
                child[node][S[j]] = n_node
                n_node += 1
            node = child[node][S[j]]
        is_end[node] = True
    child = child[:n_node]
    is_end = is_end[:n_node]
    ans = 0
    for i in range(N):
        se = 0
        for j in range(r_ind[i] - 1, l_ind[i] - 1, -1):
            se |= 1 << S[j]
            node = path[j]
            for k in range(26):
                if se & 1 << k:
                    if is_end[child[node][k]]:
                        ans += 1
    return ans - N

class rh:#base,max_n=ありうる文字の最大長,convertを指定すること
    def __init__(self,base,max_n):#baseとmaxnを指定すること。baseは偶数(modが奇数)
        self.mod=random.randrange(1<<54-1,1<<55-1,2)#奇数、衝突させられないよう乱数で生成

            cur1=cur1*base%self.mod
            self.pows1[i]=cur1

    def get(self, s):#特定の文字のhash. O(|s|)
        n=len(s)
        mod=self.mod
        si=[self.convert(ss) for ss in s]

        for i in range(n):h1=(h1+si[i]*self.pows1[n-1-i])%mod
        return h1

class RollingHash:
    def __init__(self, string):
        self.n = len(string)
        self.BASE = 1234
        self.MASK30 = (1 << 30) - 1
        self.MASK31 = (1 << 31) - 1
        self.MASK61 = (1 << 61) - 1
        self.MOD = self.MASK61
        self.hash = [0] * (self.n + 1)
        self.pow = [1] * (self.n + 1)

        for i, char in enumerate(string):
            self.hash[i + 1] = self.calc_mod(self.mul(self.hash[i], self.BASE) + ord(char))
            self.pow[i + 1] = self.calc_mod(self.mul(self.pow[i], self.BASE))

    def calc_mod(self, x):
        """x mod 2^61-1 を返す。"""
        xu = x >> 61
        xd = x & self.MASK61
        x = xu + xd
        if x >= self.MOD:
            x -= MASK61
        return x

    def mul(self, a, b):
        """a*b mod 2^61-1 を返す。"""
        au = a >> 31
        ad = a & self.MASK31
        bu = b >> 31
        bd = b & self.MASK31
        mid = ad * bu + au * bd
        midu = mid >> 30
        midd = mid & self.MASK30
        return self.calc_mod(au * bu * 2 + midu + (midd << 31) + ad * bd)

    def get_hash(self, l, r):
        """string[l:r]のハッシュ値を返す。O(1)"""
        res = self.calc_mod(self.hash[r] - self.mul(self.hash[l], self.pow[r - l]))
        return res

def fact_and_inv(SIZE):
    inv = [0] * SIZE  # inv[j] = j^{-1} mod MOD
    fac = [0] * SIZE  # fac[j] = j! mod MOD
    finv = [0] * SIZE  # finv[j] = (j!)^{-1} mod MOD
    inv[1] = 1
    fac[0] = fac[1] = 1
    finv[0] = finv[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, SIZE):
        inv[i] = MOD - (MOD // i) * inv[MOD % i] % MOD
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD
        finv[i] = finv[i - 1] * inv[i] % MOD

    return fac, finv

            self.pows1[i]=cur1

        n=len(s)
        mod=self.mod
        si=[self.convert(ss) for ss in s]
        h1=0
        for i in range(n):h1=(h1+si[i]*self.pows1[n-1-i])%mod
        return h1
    
    def get_roll(self, s, k, uroboros=False):#ローリングハッシュ,sの各文字を始点とした長さkの部分文字のhash値をすべて得る,O(|s|)

        n=len(s)
        maxitr=n-k+1
        if uroboros: maxitr=n
    
        si=[self.convert(ss) for ss in s]
        mod=self.mod
        h1=0
        for i in range(k):h1=(h1+si[i%n]*self.pows1[k-1-i])%mod
        hs=[0]*maxitr

        mbase1=self.pows1[k]

        for i in range(1,maxitr): 
            front=si[i-1];back=si[(i+k-1)%n]
            h1=(h1*base-front*mbase1+back)%mod
            hs[i]=h1
        return hs

        self.length = len(s)
        self.base = 1009
        self.mod = (1 << 31) - 1
        self.hash = [0] * (self.length + 2)
        self.pow = [1] * (self.length + 2)

        for i in range(self.length):
            self.hash[i+1] = (self.hash[i] + ord(s[i])) * self.base % self.mod
            self.pow[i+1] = self.pow[i] * self.base % self.mod
        self.pow[self.length+1] = self.pow[self.length] * self.base % self.mod

        return t % self.mod
    
    def get_wsuff(self, l, r, suff):
        hash_suff = (self.hash[r] + ord(suff)) * self.base % self.mod
        t = hash_suff - self.hash[l] * self.pow[r+1-l] % self.mod
        return t % self.mod

MASK30 = (1 << 30) - 1
MASK31 = (1 << 31) - 1
MASK61 = (1 << 61) - 1

@njit((i8, ), cache=True)
def rh_modulo(x):
    xu, xd = x >> 61, x & MASK61
    x = xu + xd
    if x >= MASK61:
        x -= MASK61
    return x


@njit((i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_multiply(a, b):
    au, ad = a >> 31, a & MASK31
    bu, bd = b >> 31, b & MASK31
    x = ad * bu + au * bd
    xu, xd = x >> 30, x & MASK30
    return rh_modulo(au * bu * 2 + xu + (xd << 31) + ad * bd)


@njit((i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_pows(base, max_len):
    pows = np.empty(max_len, np.int64)
    pows[0] = 1
    for n in range(1, max_len):
        pows[n] = rh_multiply(pows[n - 1], base)
    return pows


@njit((i8[:], i8, i8[:]), cache=True)
def compute_rh(pows, base, S):
    N = len(S)
    RH = np.empty(N, np.int64)
    RH[0] = S[0] + 10
    for n in range(1, N):
        x = rh_multiply(RH[n - 1], base) + S[n] + 10
        if x >= MASK61:
            x -= MASK61
        RH[n] = x
    return RH

    sets = np.zeros_like(S)
    for i in range(N):

class SegmentTree:
  def __init__(self, n, op, e):
    self.n = n
    self.op = op
    self.e = e
    self.size = 2 ** ((n - 1).bit_length())
    self.node = [self.e] * (2 * self.size)
 
  def build(self, array):
    for i in range(self.n):
      self.node[self.size + i] = array[i]
    for i in range(self.size - 1, 0, -1):
      self.node[i] = self.op(self.node[i << 1], self.node[(i << 1) + 1])
 
  def update(self, i, val):
    i += self.size
    self.node[i] += val
    while i > 1:
      i >>= 1
      self.node[i] = self.op(self.node[i << 1], self.node[(i << 1) + 1])
 
  def get(self, l, r):
    l, r = l + self.size, r + self.size
    res_l, res_r = self.e, self.e
    while l < r:
      if l & 1:
        res_l = self.op(res_l, self.node[l])
        l += 1
      if r & 1:
        r -= 1
        res_r = self.op(self.node[r], res_r) 
      l, r = l >> 1, r >> 1
    return self.op(res_l, res_r)

        n=len(s)
        mod=self.mod
        si=[self.convert(ss) for ss in s]
        h1=0
        for i in range(n):h1=(h1+si[i]*self.pows1[n-1-i])%mod
        return h1

        n=len(s)
        maxitr=n-k+1
        if uroboros: maxitr=n
    
        si=[self.convert(ss) for ss in s]
        mod=self.mod
        h1=0
        for i in range(k):h1=(h1+si[i%n]*self.pows1[k-1-i])%mod
        hs=[0]*maxitr

        for i in range(1,maxitr): 
            front=si[i-1];back=si[(i+k-1)%n]
            h1=(h1*base-front*mbase1+back)%mod
            hs[i]=h1

class rh:#base,max_n=ありうる文字の最大長,convertを指定すること
    def __init__(self,base,max_n):#baseとmaxnを指定すること。baseは偶数(modが奇数)
        self.mod=random.randrange(1<<54-1,1<<55-1,2)#奇数、衝突させられないよう乱数で生成
        self.base=int(base*0.5+0.5)*2#偶数,英小文字なら26とか

        self.pows1=[1]*(max_n+1)
        cur1=1
        for i in range(1,max_n+1):
            cur1=cur1*base%self.mod
            self.pows1[i]=cur1

    def convert(self,c): return alp2num(c,False)#大文字の場合Trueにする
    
    def get(self, s):#特定の文字のhash. O(|s|)
        n=len(s)
        mod=self.mod
        si=[self.convert(ss) for ss in s]
        h1=0
        for i in range(n):h1=(h1+si[i]*self.pows1[n-1-i])%mod
        return h1
    
    def get_roll(self, s, k, uroboros=False):#ローリングハッシュ,sの各文字を始点とした長さkの部分文字のhash値をすべて得る,O(|s|)
        #uroboros: trueの場合文字sを循環させ、n個のハッシュ値を得る。 falseの場合n-k+1個
        n=len(s)
        maxitr=n-k+1
        if uroboros: maxitr=n
    
        si=[self.convert(ss) for ss in s]
        mod=self.mod
        h1=0
        for i in range(k):h1=(h1+si[i%n]*self.pows1[k-1-i])%mod
        hs=[0]*maxitr
        hs[0]=h1
        mbase1=self.pows1[k]
        base=self.base
        
        for i in range(1,maxitr): 
            front=si[i-1];back=si[(i+k-1)%n]
            h1=(h1*base-front*mbase1+back)%mod
            hs[i]=h1
        return hs

class RollingHash():
    def __init__(self, s):
        self.length = len(s)
        self.base = 1009
        self.mod = (1 << 61) - 1
        self.hash = [0] * (self.length + 2)
        self.pow = [1] * (self.length + 2)

        for i in range(self.length):
            self.hash[i+1] = (self.hash[i] + ord(s[i])) * self.base % self.mod
            self.pow[i+1] = self.pow[i] * self.base % self.mod
        self.pow[self.length+1] = self.pow[self.length] * self.base % self.mod 

    def get(self, l, r):
        t = self.hash[r] - self.hash[l] * self.pow[r-l] % self.mod
        return t % self.mod
    
    def get_wsuff(self, l, r, suff):
        hash_suff = (self.hash[r] + ord(suff)) * self.base % self.mod
        t = hash_suff - self.hash[l] * self.pow[r+1-l] % self.mod
        return t % self.mod

def nck(n, k, kaijyo):

def npk(n, k, kaijyo):
    if k == 0 or k == n:
        return n % MOD
    return (kaijyo[n] * divide(kaijyo[n-k])) % MOD

def fact_and_inv(SIZE):
    inv = [0] * SIZE  # inv[j] = j^{-1} mod MOD
    fac = [0] * SIZE  # fac[j] = j! mod MOD
    finv = [0] * SIZE  # finv[j] = (j!)^{-1} mod MOD
    inv[1] = 1
    fac[0] = fac[1] = 1
    finv[0] = finv[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, SIZE):
        inv[i] = MOD - (MOD // i) * inv[MOD % i] % MOD
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD
        finv[i] = finv[i - 1] * inv[i] % MOD

    return fac, finv

def renritsu(A, Y):
    # example 2x + y = 3, x + 3y = 4
    # A = [[2,1], [1,3]])
    # Y = [[3],[4]] または [3,4]
    A = np.matrix(A)
    Y = np.matrix(Y)
    Y = np.reshape(Y, (-1, 1))
    X = np.linalg.solve(A, Y)

    # [1.0, 1.0]
    return X.flatten().tolist()[0]

class RollingHash:
    def __init__(self, string):
        self.n = len(string)
        self.BASE = 1234
        self.MOD = (1 << 56) - 1
        self.hash = [0] * (self.n + 1)
        self.pow = [1] * (self.n + 1)

        for i, char in enumerate(string):
            self.hash[i + 1] = (self.hash[i] + ord(char)) * self.BASE % self.MOD
            self.pow[i + 1] = (self.pow[i] * self.BASE) % self.MOD

    def get_hash(self, l, r):
        """string[l:r]のハッシュ値を返す。O(1)"""
        res = (self.hash[r] - self.hash[l] * self.pow[r - l]) % self.MOD
        return res

class RollingHash:
    def __init__(self, string):
        self.n = len(string)
        self.BASE = 1234
        self.MASK30 = (1 << 30) - 1
        self.MASK31 = (1 << 31) - 1
        self.MASK61 = (1 << 61) - 1
        self.MOD = self.MASK61
        self.hash = [0] * (self.n + 1)
        self.pow = [1] * (self.n + 1)

        for i, char in enumerate(string):
            self.hash[i + 1] = self.calc_mod(self.mul(self.hash[i], self.BASE) + ord(char))
            self.pow[i + 1] = self.calc_mod(self.mul(self.pow[i], self.BASE))

    def calc_mod(self, x):
        """x mod 2^61-1 を返す。"""
        xu = x >> 61
        xd = x & self.MASK61
        x = xu + xd
        if x >= self.MOD:
            x -= MASK61
        return x

    def mul(self, a, b):
        """a*b mod 2^61-1 を返す。"""
        au = a >> 31
        ad = a & self.MASK31
        bu = b >> 31
        bd = b & self.MASK31
        mid = ad * bu + au * bd
        midu = mid >> 30
        midd = mid & self.MASK30
        return self.calc_mod(au * bu * 2 + midu + (midd << 31) + ad * bd)

    def get_hash(self, l, r):
        """string[l:r]のハッシュ値を返す。O(1)"""
        res = (self.hash[r] - self.hash[l] * self.pow[r - l]) % self.MOD
        return res

        P1, P2 = [1] * (self._n + 1), [1] * (self._n + 1)

        self._H1, self._H2 = H1, H2

def solve(N, SS):

    SS.sort(key=lambda s: -len(s))

    ret = 0
    table = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(set))
    shortest = INF
    for i, s in enumerate(SS):
        l = len(s)
        if shortest == INF:
            shortest = l
            table[l][s] = set([i])
        elif shortest == l:
            ret += len(table[l][s])
            table[l][s].add(i)

        elif shortest > l:
            # progress DP
            while shortest > l:
                next = shortest - 1
                for k in table[shortest]:
                    v = table[shortest][k]
                    k1 = k[0] + k[2:]
                    table[next][k1] = table[next][k1].union(v)

                shortest = next
                debug(": table[next]", table[next])
            ret += len(table[l][s])
            table[l][s].add(i)

        else:

    return ret

class RollingHash:
    def __init__(self, string):
        self.n = len(string)
        self.BASE = 1234
        self.MOD = (1 << 51) - 1
        self.hash = [0] * (self.n + 1)
        self.pow = [1] * (self.n + 1)

        for i, char in enumerate(string):
            self.hash[i + 1] = (self.hash[i] + ord(char)) * self.BASE % self.MOD
            self.pow[i + 1] = (self.pow[i] * self.BASE) % self.MOD

    def get_hash(self, l, r):
        """string[l:r]のハッシュ値を返す。O(1)"""
        res = (self.hash[r] - self.hash[l] * self.pow[r - l]) % self.MOD
        return res

MASK30 = (1 << 30) - 1
MASK31 = (1 << 31) - 1
MASK61 = (1 << 61) - 1

@njit((i8, ), cache=True)
def rh_modulo(x):
    xu, xd = x >> 61, x & MASK61
    x = xu + xd
    if x >= MASK61:
        x -= MASK61
    return x


@njit((i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_multiply(a, b):
    au, ad = a >> 31, a & MASK31
    bu, bd = b >> 31, b & MASK31
    x = ad * bu + au * bd
    xu, xd = x >> 30, x & MASK30
    return rh_modulo(au * bu * 2 + xu + (xd << 31) + ad * bd)


@njit((i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_pows(base, max_len):
    pows = np.empty(max_len, np.int64)
    pows[0] = 1
    for n in range(1, max_len):
        pows[n] = rh_multiply(pows[n - 1], base)
    return pows


@njit((i8[:], i8, i8[:]), cache=True)
def compute_rh(pows, base, S):
    N = len(S)
    RH = np.empty(N, np.int64)
    RH[0] = S[0] + 10
    for n in range(1, N):
        x = rh_multiply(RH[n - 1], base) + S[n] + 10
        if x >= MASK61:
            x -= MASK61
        RH[n] = x
    return RH


@njit((i8[:], i8, i8[:], i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_substr(pows, base, RH, l, r):
    h = RH[r]
    if l > 0:
        h -= rh_multiply(RH[l], pows[r - l])
    if h < 0:
        h += MASK61
    return h

@njit((i8[:], ), cache=True)
def main(S):
    S = S.copy()
    l_ind = np.where(S == -1)[0][:-1] + 1
    r_ind = np.where(S == -1)[0][1:]
    N = len(l_ind)
    # 逆順にしておく
    for i in range(N):
        S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]] = S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]][::-1]

    # rolling hashの計算
    max_len = len(S) + 10
    base = np.random.randint(0, 1 << 31)
    pows = rh_pows(base, max_len)
    RH = np.zeros_like(S)
    for i in range(N):
        RH[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]] = compute_rh(pows, base, S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]])

    # 後ろ（自身も含む）に置ける文字集合の計算
    sets = np.zeros_like(S)
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(r_ind[i] - 1, l_ind[i] - 1, -1):
            sets[j] = sets[j + 1] | 1 << S[j]

    # 作れる組 (prefix, 右からの1文字)をすべて計算する
    ptr = 0
    nums = np.empty(len(S) * 26 + 10, np.int64)
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(l_ind[i], r_ind[i]):
            for k in range(26):
                if sets[j] & 1 << k:
                    h = rh_multiply(RH[j - 1], base) + k
                    nums[ptr] = h
                    ptr += 1

MASK30 = (1 << 30) - 1
MASK31 = (1 << 31) - 1
MASK61 = (1 << 61) - 1

@njit((i8, ), cache=True)
def rh_modulo(x):
    xu, xd = x >> 61, x & MASK61
    x = xu + xd
    if x >= MASK61:
        x -= MASK61
    return x


@njit((i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_multiply(a, b):
    au, ad = a >> 31, a & MASK31
    bu, bd = b >> 31, b & MASK31
    x = ad * bu + au * bd
    xu, xd = x >> 30, x & MASK30
    return rh_modulo(au * bu * 2 + xu + (xd << 31) + ad * bd)


@njit((i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_pows(base, max_len):
    pows = np.empty(max_len, np.int64)
    pows[0] = 1
    for n in range(1, max_len):
        pows[n] = rh_multiply(pows[n - 1], base)
    return pows


@njit((i8[:], i8, i8[:]), cache=True)
def compute_rh(pows, base, S):
    N = len(S)
    RH = np.empty(N, np.int64)
    RH[0] = S[0]
    for n in range(1, N):
        x = rh_multiply(RH[n - 1], base) + S[n]
        if x >= MASK61:
            x -= MASK61
        RH[n] = x
    return RH


@njit((i8[:], i8, i8[:], i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_substr(pows, base, RH, l, r):
    h = RH[r]
    if l > 0:
        h -= rh_multiply(RH[l], pows[r - l])
    if h < 0:
        h += MASK61
    return h

@njit((i8[:], ), cache=True)
def main(S):
    S = S.copy()
    l_ind = np.where(S == -1)[0][:-1] + 1
    r_ind = np.where(S == -1)[0][1:]
    N = len(l_ind)
    # 逆順にしておく
    for i in range(N):
        S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]] = S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]][::-1]

    # rolling hashの計算
    max_len = len(S) + 10
    base = np.random.randint(0, 1<<31)
    pows = rh_pows(base, max_len)
    RH = np.zeros_like(S)
    for i in range(N):
        RH[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]] = compute_rh(pows, base, S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]])

    # 後ろ（自身も含む）に置ける文字集合の計算
    sets = np.zeros_like(S)
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(r_ind[i] - 1, l_ind[i] - 1, -1):
            sets[j] = sets[j + 1] | 1 << S[j]

    # 作れる組 (prefix, 右からの1文字)をすべて計算する
    ptr = 0
    nums = np.empty(len(S) * 26 + 10, np.int64)
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(l_ind[i], r_ind[i]):
            for k in range(26):
                if sets[j] & 1 << k:
                    h = rh_multiply(RH[j - 1], base) + k
                    nums[ptr] = h
                    ptr += 1
    nums = nums[:ptr]
    nums.sort()
    # 各文字列とマッチングする対象を数える
    ans = 0
    for i in range(N):
        h = rh_multiply(RH[r_ind[i] - 2], base) + S[r_ind[i] - 1]
        cnt = np.searchsorted(nums, h, 'right')
        cnt -= np.searchsorted(nums, h, 'left')
        ans += cnt - 1  # 自分を除外
    print(ans)

def factorization(n):
  arr = []
  temp = n
  for i in range(2, int(-(-n**0.5//1))+1):
    if temp%i==0:
      cnt=0
      while temp%i==0: 
        cnt+=1 
        temp //= i
      arr.append([i, cnt])
  if temp!=1: arr.append([temp, 1])
  if arr==[]: arr.append([n, 1])
  return arr

      divisors.append(i)
      if i != n // i: 
        divisors.append(n//i)
  return divisors

def make_primes(N):
  max = int(math.sqrt(N))
  seachList = [i for i in range(2,N+1)]
  primeNum = []
  while seachList[0] <= max:
    primeNum.append(seachList[0])
    tmp = seachList[0]
    seachList = [i for i in seachList if i % tmp != 0]
  primeNum.extend(seachList)
  return primeNum

class Trie:
    def __init__(self):
        root = TrieNode()
        self.nodes = [root]

    def __add_node(self, node):
        self.nodes.append(node)
        return len(self.nodes) - 1

    def __get_char_num(self, c):
        #文字列の番号を返す関数
        return ord(c) - ord('a')

    def insert(self ,word, item):
        """Trieに新しい単語を登録する
        word : str 登録する単語
        item : wordに格納するvalue
        """
        char_index=0; node_index=0
        lw=len(word)
        for char_index in range(lw):
            char_num = self.__get_char_num(word[char_index])
            next_node_index = self.nodes[node_index].children[char_num]
            if next_node_index == -1:
                # 現在のノードにword[char_index]での遷移がなかった場合
                new_node = TrieNode()
                next_node_index = self.__add_node(new_node)
                self.nodes[node_index].children[char_num] = next_node_index
            node_index=next_node_index
            
        self.nodes[node_index].item = item

    def get_node(self, word):
        """
        検索
        word : str
        return : node.item or None
        """
        node_index = 0

        for c in word:
            char_num = self.__get_char_num(c)
            tmp_node = self.nodes[node_index]
            
            node_index = tmp_node.children[char_num]
            if node_index == -1:
                return None
        return self.nodes[node_index]


    def query(self, word):
        """
        検索
        word : str
        return : node.item or None
        """
        node_index = 0

        for c in word:
            char_num = self.__get_char_num(c)
            tmp_node = self.nodes[node_index]
            
            node_index = tmp_node.children[char_num]
            if node_index == -1:
                return None
        return node_index,self.nodes[node_index].item

import random
class rh:#base,max_n=ありうる文字の最大長,convertを指定すること
    def __init__(self,base,max_n):#baseとmaxnを指定すること。baseは偶数(modが奇数)
        self.mod=random.randrange(1<<54-1,1<<55-1,2)#奇数、衝突させられないよう乱数で生成
        self.base=int(base*0.5+0.5)*2#偶数,英小文字なら26とか
        self.max_n=max_n
        self.pows1=[1]*(max_n+1)
        cur1=1
        for i in range(1,max_n+1):
            cur1=cur1*base%self.mod
            self.pows1[i]=cur1

    def convert(self,c): return alp2num(c,False)#大文字の場合Trueにする
    
    def get(self, s):#特定の文字のhash. O(|s|)
        n=len(s)
        mod=self.mod
        si=[self.convert(ss) for ss in s]
        h1=0
        for i in range(n):h1=(h1+si[i]*self.pows1[n-1-i])%mod
        return h1
    
    def get_roll(self, s, k, uroboros=False):#ローリングハッシュ,sの各文字を始点とした長さkの部分文字のhash値をすべて得る,O(|s|)
        #uroboros: trueの場合文字sを循環させ、n個のハッシュ値を得る。 falseの場合n-k+1個
        n=len(s)
        maxitr=n-k+1
        if uroboros: maxitr=n
    
        si=[self.convert(ss) for ss in s]
        mod=self.mod
        h1=0
        for i in range(k):h1=(h1+si[i%n]*self.pows1[k-1-i])%mod
        hs=[0]*maxitr
        hs[0]=h1
        mbase1=self.pows1[k]
        base=self.base
        
        for i in range(1,maxitr): 
            front=si[i-1];back=si[(i+k-1)%n]
            h1=(h1*base-front*mbase1+back)%mod
            hs[i]=h1
        return hs

class RollingHash:
    def __init__(self, string):
        self.n = len(string)
        self.BASE = 1234
        self.MOD = (1 << 45) - 1
        self.hash = [0] * (self.n + 1)
        self.pow = [1] * (self.n + 1)

        for i, char in enumerate(string):
            self.hash[i + 1] = (self.hash[i] + ord(char)) * self.BASE % self.MOD
            self.pow[i + 1] = (self.pow[i] * self.BASE) % self.MOD

    def get_hash(self, l, r):
        """string[l:r]のハッシュ値を返す。O(1)"""
        res = (self.hash[r] - self.hash[l] * self.pow[r - l]) % self.MOD
        return res

class SegmentTree:
  def __init__(self, n, op, e):
    self.n = n
    self.op = op
    self.e = e
    self.size = 2 ** ((n - 1).bit_length())
    self.node = [self.e] * (2 * self.size)
 
  def build(self, array):
    for i in range(self.n):
      self.node[self.size + i] = array[i]
    for i in range(self.size - 1, 0, -1):
      self.node[i] = self.op(self.node[i << 1], self.node[(i << 1) + 1])
 
  def update(self, i, val):
    i += self.size
    self.node[i] += val
    while i > 1:
      i >>= 1
      self.node[i] = self.op(self.node[i << 1], self.node[(i << 1) + 1])
 
  def get(self, l, r):
    l, r = l + self.size, r + self.size
    res_l, res_r = self.e, self.e
    while l < r:
      if l & 1:
        res_l = self.op(res_l, self.node[l])
        l += 1
      if r & 1:
        r -= 1
        res_r = self.op(self.node[r], res_r) 
      l, r = l >> 1, r >> 1
    return self.op(res_l, res_r)

def fact_and_inv(SIZE):
    inv = [0] * SIZE  # inv[j] = j^{-1} mod MOD
    fac = [0] * SIZE  # fac[j] = j! mod MOD
    finv = [0] * SIZE  # finv[j] = (j!)^{-1} mod MOD

MASK30 = (1 << 30) - 1
MASK31 = (1 << 31) - 1
MASK61 = (1 << 61) - 1

@njit((i8, ), cache=True)
def rh_modulo(x):
    xu, xd = x >> 61, x & MASK61
    x = xu + xd
    if x >= MASK61:
        x -= MASK61
    return x


@njit((i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_multiply(a, b):
    au, ad = a >> 31, a & MASK31
    bu, bd = b >> 31, b & MASK31
    x = ad * bu + au * bd
    xu, xd = x >> 30, x & MASK30
    return rh_modulo(au * bu * 2 + xu + (xd << 31) + ad * bd)


@njit((i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_pows(base, max_len):
    pows = np.empty(max_len, np.int64)
    pows[0] = 1
    for n in range(1, max_len):
        pows[n] = rh_multiply(pows[n - 1], base)
    return pows


@njit((i8[:], i8, i8[:]), cache=True)
def compute_rh(pows, base, S):
    N = len(S)
    RH = np.empty(N, np.int64)
    RH[0] = S[0] + 10
    for n in range(1, N):
        x = rh_multiply(RH[n - 1], base) + S[n] + 10
        if x >= MASK61:
            x -= MASK61
        RH[n] = x
    return RH


@njit((i8[:], i8, i8[:], i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_substr(pows, base, RH, l, r):
    h = RH[r]
    if l > 0:
        h -= rh_multiply(RH[l], pows[r - l])
    if h < 0:
        h += MASK61
    return h

@njit((i8[:], ), cache=True)
def main(S):
    S = S.copy()
    l_ind = np.where(S == -1)[0][:-1] + 1
    r_ind = np.where(S == -1)[0][1:]
    N = len(l_ind)
    # 逆順にしておく
    for i in range(N):
        S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]] = S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]][::-1]

    # rolling hashの計算
    max_len = len(S) + 10
    base = np.random.randint(0, 1 << 31)
    pows = rh_pows(base, max_len)
    RH = np.zeros_like(S)
    for i in range(N):
        RH[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]] = compute_rh(pows, base, S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]])

    # 後ろ（自身も含む）に置ける文字集合の計算
    sets = np.zeros_like(S)
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(r_ind[i] - 1, l_ind[i] - 1, -1):
            sets[j] = sets[j + 1] | 1 << S[j]

    # 作れる組 (prefix, 右からの1文字)をすべて計算する
    ptr = 0
    nums = np.empty(len(S) * 26 + 10, np.int64)
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(l_ind[i], r_ind[i]):
            for k in range(26):
                if sets[j] & 1 << k:
                    h = rh_multiply(RH[j - 1], base) + k
                    nums[ptr] = h
                    ptr += 1
    nums = nums[:ptr]
    nums = nums[np.argsort(nums, kind='mergesort')]
    # 各文字列とマッチングする対象を数える
    ans = 0
    for i in range(N):

        cnt = np.searchsorted(nums, h, 'right')
        cnt -= np.searchsorted(nums, h, 'left')
        ans += cnt - 1  # 自分を除外
    print(ans)

        self.length = len(s)
        self.base = 1009
        self.mod = (1 << 61) - 1
        self.hash = [0] * (self.length + 2)
        self.pow = [1] * (self.length + 2)

        for i in range(self.length):
            self.hash[i+1] = (self.hash[i] + ord(s[i])) * self.base % self.mod
            self.pow[i+1] = self.pow[i] * self.base % self.mod
        self.pow[self.length+1] = self.pow[self.length] * self.base % self.mod 

    def get(self, l, r):
        t = self.hash[r] - self.hash[l] * self.pow[r-l] % self.mod
        return t % self.mod
    
    def get_wsuff(self, l, r, suff):
        hash_suff = (self.hash[r] + ord(suff)) * self.base % self.mod
        t = hash_suff - self.hash[l] * self.pow[r+1-l] % self.mod
        return t % self.mod

MASK30 = (1 << 30) - 1
MASK31 = (1 << 31) - 1
MASK61 = (1 << 61) - 1

@njit((i8, ), cache=True)
def rh_modulo(x):
    xu, xd = x >> 61, x & MASK61
    x = xu + xd
    if x >= MASK61:
        x -= MASK61
    return x


@njit((i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_multiply(a, b):
    au, ad = a >> 31, a & MASK31
    bu, bd = b >> 31, b & MASK31
    x = ad * bu + au * bd
    xu, xd = x >> 30, x & MASK30
    return rh_modulo(au * bu * 2 + xu + (xd << 31) + ad * bd)


@njit((i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_pows(base, max_len):
    pows = np.empty(max_len, np.int64)
    pows[0] = 1
    for n in range(1, max_len):
        pows[n] = rh_multiply(pows[n - 1], base)
    return pows


@njit((i8[:], i8, i8[:]), cache=True)
def compute_rh(pows, base, S):
    N = len(S)
    RH = np.empty(N, np.int64)
    RH[0] = S[0] + 10
    for n in range(1, N):
        x = rh_multiply(RH[n - 1], base) + S[n] + 10
        if x >= MASK61:
            x -= MASK61
        RH[n] = x
    return RH


@njit((i8[:], i8, i8[:], i8, i8), cache=True)
def rh_substr(pows, base, RH, l, r):
    h = RH[r]
    if l > 0:
        h -= rh_multiply(RH[l], pows[r - l])
    if h < 0:
        h += MASK61
    return h

@njit((i8[:], ), cache=True)
def main(S):
    S = S.copy()
    l_ind = np.where(S == -1)[0][:-1] + 1
    r_ind = np.where(S == -1)[0][1:]
    N = len(l_ind)
    # 逆順にしておく
    for i in range(N):
        S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]] = S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]][::-1]

    # rolling hashの計算
    max_len = len(S) + 10
    base = np.random.randint(0, 1 << 31)
    base = 1000
    pows = rh_pows(base, max_len)
    RH = np.zeros_like(S)
    full_RH = np.empty(N, np.int64)
    for i in range(N):
        RH[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]] = compute_rh(pows, base, S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]])
        full_RH[i] = RH[r_ind[i] - 1]
    # 後ろ（自身も含む）に置ける文字集合の計算
    sets = np.zeros_like(S)
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(r_ind[i] - 1, l_ind[i] - 1, -1):
            sets[j] = sets[j + 1] | 1 << S[j]

    full_RH.sort()

    # 作れる組 (prefix, 右からの1文字)をすべて計算する
    ans = 0
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(l_ind[i], r_ind[i]):
            for k in range(26):
                if sets[j] & 1 << k:
                    h = rh_multiply(RH[j - 1], base) + k + 10
                    cnt = np.searchsorted(full_RH, h, 'right')
                    cnt -= np.searchsorted(full_RH, h, 'left')
                    ans += cnt
    ans -= N
    return ans

class RollingHash():
    def __init__(self, s, base, mod):
        self.mod = mod
        self.pw = pw = [1]*(len(s)+1)

        l = len(s)
        self.h = h = [0]*(l+1)

        v = 0
        for i in range(l):
            h[i+1] = v = (v * base + ord(s[i])) % mod
        v = 1
        for i in range(l):
            pw[i+1] = v = v * base % mod
    def get(self, l, r):
        return (self.h[r] - self.h[l] * self.pw[r-l]) % self.mod

def fact_and_inv(SIZE):
    inv = [0] * SIZE  # inv[j] = j^{-1} mod MOD
    fac = [0] * SIZE  # fac[j] = j! mod MOD
    finv = [0] * SIZE  # finv[j] = (j!)^{-1} mod MOD
    inv[1] = 1
    fac[0] = fac[1] = 1
    finv[0] = finv[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, SIZE):
        inv[i] = MOD - (MOD // i) * inv[MOD % i] % MOD
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD
        finv[i] = finv[i - 1] * inv[i] % MOD

    return fac, finv

        n=len(s)
        mod=self.mod
        si=[self.convert(ss) for ss in s]
        h1=0
        for i in range(n):h1=(h1+si[i]*self.pows1[n-1-i])%mod

        n=len(s)

        si=[self.convert(ss) for ss in s]
        mod=self.mod
        h1=0
        for i in range(k):h1=(h1+si[i%n]*self.pows1[k-1-i])%mod
        hs=[0]*maxitr
        hs[0]=h1

        for i in range(1,maxitr): 
            front=si[i-1];back=si[(i+k-1)%n]
            h1=(h1*base-front*mbase1+back)%mod
            hs[i]=h1
        return hs

class SegmentTree:
  def __init__(self, n, op, e):
    self.n = n
    self.op = op
    self.e = e
    self.size = 2 ** ((n - 1).bit_length())
    self.node = [self.e] * (2 * self.size)
 
  def build(self, array):
    for i in range(self.n):
      self.node[self.size + i] = array[i]
    for i in range(self.size - 1, 0, -1):
      self.node[i] = self.op(self.node[i << 1], self.node[(i << 1) + 1])
 
  def update(self, i, val):
    i += self.size
    self.node[i] += val
    while i > 1:
      i >>= 1
      self.node[i] = self.op(self.node[i << 1], self.node[(i << 1) + 1])
 
  def get(self, l, r):
    l, r = l + self.size, r + self.size
    res_l, res_r = self.e, self.e
    while l < r:
      if l & 1:
        res_l = self.op(res_l, self.node[l])
        l += 1
      if r & 1:
        r -= 1
        res_r = self.op(self.node[r], res_r) 
      l, r = l >> 1, r >> 1
    return self.op(res_l, res_r)

class RollingHash():
    def __init__(self, s):
        self.length = len(s)
        self.base = 1009
        self.mod = (1 << 61) - 1
        self.hash = [0] * (self.length + 2)

        for i in range(self.length):
            self.hash[i+1] = (self.hash[i] + ord(s[i])) * self.base % self.mod

    def get(self, l, r):
        t = self.hash[r] - self.hash[l] * mod_pow[r-l] % self.mod
        return t % self.mod

@njit((i8[:], ), cache=True)
def main(S):
    S = S.copy()
    l_ind = np.where(S == -1)[0][:-1] + 1
    r_ind = np.where(S == -1)[0][1:]

    # 逆順にしておく
    N = len(l_ind)
    for i in range(N):
        S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]] = S[l_ind[i]:r_ind[i]][::-1]

    # Trie木の構築
    path = np.zeros_like(S)
    child = np.zeros((len(S), 26), np.int64)
    is_end = np.zeros(len(S), np.bool_)

    n_node = 1
    for i in range(N):
        node = 0
        for j in range(l_ind[i], r_ind[i]):
            path[j] = node
            if child[node][S[j]] == 0:
                child[node][S[j]] = n_node
                n_node += 1
            node = child[node][S[j]]
        is_end[node] = True
    child = child[:n_node]
    is_end = is_end[:n_node]
    ans = 0
    for i in range(N):
        se = 0
        for j in range(r_ind[i] - 1, l_ind[i] - 1, -1):
            se |= 1 << S[j]
            node = path[j]
            for k in range(26):
                if se & 1 << k:
                    if is_end[child[node][k]]:
                        ans += 1
    return ans - N

class SegmentTree:
  def __init__(self, n, op, e):
    self.n = n
    self.op = op
    self.e = e
    self.size = 2 ** ((n - 1).bit_length())
    self.node = [self.e] * (2 * self.size)
 
  def build(self, array):
    for i in range(self.n):
      self.node[self.size + i] = array[i]
    for i in range(self.size - 1, 0, -1):
      self.node[i] = self.op(self.node[i << 1], self.node[(i << 1) + 1])
 
  def update(self, i, val):
    i += self.size
    self.node[i] += val
    while i > 1:
      i >>= 1
      self.node[i] = self.op(self.node[i << 1], self.node[(i << 1) + 1])
 
  def get(self, l, r):
    l, r = l + self.size, r + self.size
    res_l, res_r = self.e, self.e
    while l < r:
      if l & 1:
        res_l = self.op(res_l, self.node[l])
        l += 1
      if r & 1:
        r -= 1
        res_r = self.op(self.node[r], res_r) 
      l, r = l >> 1, r >> 1
    return self.op(res_l, res_r)

import random

VOCAB_SIZE = 26 # 語彙数(小文字なら26)
class TrieNode:
    """  Trie木のノード
    item : 単語に登録するvalue, 単語終端ノード以外の場合はNone
    children : list 子ノードのリスト
    """

    def __init__(self, item = None):
        self.item = item
        self.children = [-1 for i in range(VOCAB_SIZE)]

    def __str__(self):
        ret = ""
        ret = ret + "item = {}\n".format(self.item)
        ret = ret + "children = \n{}".format(self.children)
        return ret

class Trie:
    def __init__(self):
        root = TrieNode()
        self.nodes = [root]

    def __add_node(self, node):
        self.nodes.append(node)
        return len(self.nodes) - 1

    def __get_char_num(self, c):
        #文字列の番号を返す関数
        return ord(c) - ord('a')

    def insert(self ,word, item):
        """Trieに新しい単語を登録する
        word : str 登録する単語
        item : wordに格納するvalue
        """
        char_index=0; node_index=0
        lw=len(word)
        for char_index in range(lw):
            char_num = self.__get_char_num(word[char_index])
            next_node_index = self.nodes[node_index].children[char_num]
            if next_node_index == -1:
                # 現在のノードにword[char_index]での遷移がなかった場合
                new_node = TrieNode()
                next_node_index = self.__add_node(new_node)
                self.nodes[node_index].children[char_num] = next_node_index
            node_index=next_node_index
            
        self.nodes[node_index].item = item

    def query(self, word):
        """
        検索
        word : str
        return : node.item or None
        """
        node_index = 0

        for c in word:
            char_num = self.__get_char_num(c)
            tmp_node = self.nodes[node_index]
            
            node_index = tmp_node.children[char_num]
            if node_index == -1:
                return None

        return self.nodes[node_index].item

				current = new_node

		res += currentFlag[char_index]

def fact_and_inv(SIZE):
    inv = [0] * SIZE  # inv[j] = j^{-1} mod MOD
    fac = [0] * SIZE  # fac[j] = j! mod MOD
    finv = [0] * SIZE  # finv[j] = (j!)^{-1} mod MOD
    inv[1] = 1
    fac[0] = fac[1] = 1
    finv[0] = finv[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, SIZE):
        inv[i] = MOD - (MOD // i) * inv[MOD % i] % MOD
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD
        finv[i] = finv[i - 1] * inv[i] % MOD

    return fac, finv

class RollingHash:
    def __init__(self, string):
        self.n = len(string)
        self.BASE = 1234
        self.MOD = (1 << 61) - 1
        self.hash = [0] * (self.n + 1)
        self.pow = [1] * (self.n + 1)

        for i, char in enumerate(string):
            self.hash[i + 1] = (self.hash[i] * self.BASE + ord(char)) % self.MOD
            self.pow[i + 1] = (self.pow[i] * self.BASE) % self.MOD

    def get_hash(self, l, r):
        """string[l:r]のハッシュ値を返す。O(1)"""
        res = (self.hash[r] - self.hash[l] * self.pow[r - l]) % self.MOD
        return res

    for (i, c) in v.bytes().filter_map(|c| { let c = tbl[c as usize]; if c < 64 { Some(c) } else { None } }).enumerate() {
        match i % 4 {
            0 => buf = c << 2,
            1 => { ret.push(buf | c >> 4); buf = c << 4; }
            2 => { ret.push(buf | c >> 2); buf = c << 6; }
            3 => ret.push(buf | c),
            _ => unreachable!(),
        }
    }
    ret
}
